page_data.en:
Extract from Intelligence Report 22.3.32.
------
Alleged rebel - Court proceedings
Tsiang Ming-tsih who was arrested at 744 Sze Wei
Li, Seymour Road, on March 19 on a Shanghai Special District
Court warrant (issued at the request of the Bureau of
Public Safety), charging him with being a rebel, appeared
before Court on March 21 when representatives of the
Bureau of Public Safety applied for his extradition.
The Court,however, ruled that the Safety Bureau had not
made out a prima facie case and ordered a remand until
23 to enable the Bureau to produce two prisoners in its
custody who had implicated the accused.
page_data.zh:
摘自32年3月22日的情报报告。
------
涉嫌叛乱分子 - 法庭诉讼程序
蒋明之（Tsiang Ming-tsih）于3月19日持上海特区地方法院传票（应公安局请求签发），以叛乱罪名在西摩路（Seymour Road）四维里744号被捕，并于3月21日出庭，当时公安局代表申请将其引渡。
然而，法院裁定公安局尚未确立表面证据确凿的案件，并命令还押至23日，以便该局提审两名在其羁押下且牵涉被告的囚犯。

21.3.32.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-
Statements taken personally from Instigators of the
South-Eastern Self-Defence Army
According to information secured by a report of
the Kyo Min News Agency, after the extradition of the
prisoners of the South-Eastern Self-Defence Army from the
2nd Branch Kiangsu High Court to the Public Safety Bureau,
Colonel Vung Ying Shing, Chief of the Bureau, instructed the
Investigation Office of the 3rd Section to undertake the
responsibility for conducting the examination of the case.
Strict inquiries have been in progress and the truth of
the case has gradually come out. A report on the case
has been submitted respectively to the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters and the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai for instructions.
On the afternoon of March 20, Wong Yee Ngoh, Chief
of the Military Department of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commissioner's Headquarters, in company with his assistants,
visited the offices of the Public Safety Bureau, and ordered
the offenders of the South-Eastern Self-Defence Army to be
brought before him when he personally secured their
statements.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：
亲自讯问东南自卫军煽动者所得供词
据京民通讯社报道获悉的消息，在东南自卫军囚犯从江苏高等法院第二分院移交给公安局后，该局局长温应星上校指示第三科调查股承担审讯此案的责任。
严密的讯问正在进行中，案件真相逐渐水落石出。关于此案的报告已分别提交至淞沪警备司令部和大上海特别市政府，以待指示。
3月20日下午，淞沪警备司令部军法处处长黄毅吾及其助手前往公安局办公处，命令将东南自卫军案犯带至其面前，并亲自获取了他们的供词。

Political (8)

Arrest of alleged Rebel

As a result of a statement made by one of the ten
Chinese arrested in the Great Eastern Hotel on March 12
and subsequently extradited to the Chinese Authorities
on a charge of plotting a coup d'etat at Nantao, one
Tsing Ming-taih (蔣明檉), a Szechuanese who claimed to
be one time secretary and advisers to Dr. Sun Yat-sen,
Li Yuan-hung, Yuan Shih-kai and Feng Kuo-tsang during
their respective regimes, was arrested at 744 Sze Wei
Li, Seymour Road at 12 noon March 12 on a Special District
Court Warrant charging him with being a rebel. He will
appear before Court to-day when the Chinese Authorities
will apply for his extradition.

政治类 (8)

逮捕涉嫌叛乱分子

由于3月12日在大东旅馆被捕的十名华人之一作出供词，随后这些人以在南市策划政变的罪名被引渡给中国当局，一名自称曾在孙中山、黎元洪、袁世凯和冯国璋各自执政时期担任秘书和顾问的四川人蒋明台（Tsing Ming-taih，原文注：蔣明檉），于3月12日中午12时持特区地方法院传票，以叛乱罪名在西摩路（Seymour Road）四维里744号被捕。他将于今日出庭，届时中国当局将申请将其引渡。

Extract from Chinese Newspapers Translation
17.3.32.

Members of the South-Eastern Self-Defence Army questioned
by the Bureau of Public Safety

All ten men including one Chang Min Yuan of the
South-Eastern Self-defence Army organized in the Datung
Hotel, after careful investigation by the Court, were sent
the day before yesterday to the Bureau of Public Safety
of the Shanghai Special District where they were questioned
one by one during the night. According to the statement
unanimously confirmed by the ten men, the Southern-Eastern
Self-defence Army is an organization the principle of which
is national salvation in resisting Japan.

They regretted they were unable to proceed to the
front to fight for the Nation and refused to admit that they
had any other purposes. Furthermore, they stated that formerly
they had all been high military officers, possession excellent
records, so they will never permit themselves to attempt any
violation of the law.

The Bureau of Public Safety reported the matter to the
higher officials and the case may be submitted in the near
future to Nanking for final investigation.

In its issue of March 16th the "Kuo Nan Wan Ker"
reports the following on the above cases:

Rumoured that South-Eastern Self-defence Army
Organized by the Japanese

According to the information from the Bureau of
Public Safety, it appears that the purposes for organizing the
South-Eastern Army are rather puzzling. Chief Police Officer
Yang of the Bureau was approached with the proposal to serve

公安局讯问东南自卫军成员

包括张明远在内的十名在大通旅馆组织的东南自卫军成员，经法院仔细调查后，于前天被送往上海特区公安局，并在夜间逐一接受讯问。根据这十人一致确认的供词，东南自卫军是一个以抗日救国为宗旨的组织。

他们表示遗憾未能前往前线为国作战，并拒绝承认有任何其他目的。此外，他们声称以前都是高级军官，拥有良好的履历，因此绝不会允许自己尝试任何违法行为。

公安局已将此事上报上级官员，该案可能在不久的将来提交南京进行最终调查。

3月16日出版的《国民晚报》就上述案件报道如下：

谣传东南自卫军由日本人组织

据公安局消息，组织东南军的目的似乎相当令人困惑。有人向该局杨警官提议，由其担任

page_data.en:
- 2 -

as Divisional Commander of the 3rd Division. Wang pretended
to accept the appointment, but privately reported this matter
to Mr. Wen, the chief of the Bureau of Public Safety. Further
investigations disclosed that the above Army was formed in
accordance with instructions from a certain Chinese, named
Chow, and arms and ammunitions were supplied by the Japanese.
It appears that the sole object of this organization was to
seize political reign of powers of Shanghai and destroy the
good order at present prevailing in Nantao.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

第三师师长。王假装接受任命，但私下将此事项报告给公安局长温先生。进一步调查显示，上述军队是根据一位姓周的中国人的指示组建的，武器弹药由日本人提供。看来该组织的唯一目的是夺取上海的政治统治权，并破坏南市目前的良好秩序。

Political (4)

Arrest of Revolutionaries - Plot to overthrow Bureau
of Public Safety and organize a new one

The eleven men arrested on March 12 at the request
of the Public Safety Bureau for plotting the overthrow
of the Public Safety Bureau and the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai were arraigned before the Second Branch
of the Kiangsu High Court on the morning of March 15, 1932,
when the 11th accused Tan Tsai-sien (譚財光) was released
on security and the remainder remained in custody "for
the time being". The eleven accused again appeared
before the same Court at 1.30 p.m. the same day when
the following judgment was handed down :-

"All the accused, together with the evidence
"and articles seized, are ordered to be
"handed over with the exception of Tan
"Tsai-sien (譚財光), 11th accused, who is
"to find security and surrender himself
"to the Public Safety Bureau Authorities in
"case he is required."

3月12日应公安局请求被捕的十一人，因策划推翻公安局和大上海特别市政府，于1932年3月15日上午在江苏高等法院第二分院受审，当时第十一被告谭财光（譚財光）获保释，其余人暂时“继续羁押”。这十一名被告于当日下午1时30分再次在同一法院出庭，判决如下：-

Subject (in full) Arrest of 'Revolutionaries' in the Settlement

Made by ____________________ and ____________________ Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

At 4.10 p.m. March 12, members of the Public
Safety Bureau requested assistance from Louza Station to
arrest persons who were using Rooms 29 and 34 of the Great
Eastern Hotel, Kin Wo Kan, off Nanking Road as a meeting
place where they were plotting the overthrow of the Public
Safety Bureau and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
A party of Municipal Police attended and the following nine
persons were arrested:

Lee Ming-tsoong （李敏崇）
Li Sing-ngoh （李醒我）
Soong Suh-tsang （宋武漳）
Chou Tsz-zah （周子石）
Chhu Keng-zung （周幹臣）
Iung Ngoh-ding （尹玉亭）
Woong Zoong-zung （王仲仁）
Sung Ngoh-su （孫玉書）
Tsang Ming-yuen （張明遠）

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appoint-
ment were seized showing the arrested men to belong to an
organization known as the "Headquarters of the South-Eastern
Self Defence Army"（東南自衛軍）. At 9.30 p.m. on the
same day Municipal Police with the assistance of members
of the French Police and Nantao Police searched the home
of the 2nd accused Lee Sing-ngoh （李醒我） at 7 Rue Chapsal
and seized a suitcase containing documents and correspondence
and in addition visited the home of the third accused Soong
Suh-tsang （宋武漳） at 26 Sing Ning Taung Alleyway,
Rue Brenier de Montmorand where a box containing documents
and correspondence was seized and the two persons as follows

由 ____________________ 和 ____________________ 制作 由罗伯逊巡官转发

3月12日下午4时10分，公安局成员请求老闸捕房协助，逮捕那些利用南京路附近金沃馆（Kin Wo Kan）大东旅馆29号和34号房间作为集会地点的人，他们正在策划推翻公安局和大上海特别市政府。
一队工部局警察到场，以下九人被捕：

李敏崇 （Lee Ming-tsoong）
李醒我 （Li Sing-ngoh）
宋武漳 （Soong Suh-tsang）
周子石 （Chou Tsz-zah）
周幹臣 （Chhu Keng-zung）
尹玉亭 （Iung Ngoh-ding）
王仲仁 （Woong Zoong-zung）
孫玉書 （Sung Ngoh-su）
張明遠 （Tsang Ming-yuen）

查获大量文件、印章和委任状，显示被捕人员属于一个名为“东南自卫军总部”（東南自衛軍）的组织。同日晚上9时30分，工部局警察在法国警察和南市警察的协助下，搜查了第二被告李醒我（李醒我）位于查普萨尔路（Rue Chapsal）7号的住所，查获一个装有文件和信件的公文箱，此外还走访了第三被告宋武漳（宋武漳）位于白利南路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）新宁唐弄堂26号的住所，在那里查获一个装有文件和信件的箱子，以及以下两人

The seizure at this address, on examination, however, proved of
no value and had no bearing on the case.

From statements made by the accused copies of which
are attached it appears that the Public Safety Bureau and
the offices of the various organs of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai were to be occupied by the South Eastern Self
Defence Army at a certain time on March 13. The nucleus of
this army was to consist of members of the Public Safety
Bureau and the Merchants Volunteer Corps for which assistance
$100,000 was to be paid and 2,000 rifle supplied to the
representative of the Bureau in question together with an
assurance that no dismissal or change of the present staff
of the Public Safety Bureau would be effected. The new
army when formed would be commanded by General Chow Feng-chi
(周鳳岐), who according to the statement of the first and
principal accused Li Ming-tsoong, engineered the plot under
the name of Li Ngoh (李鰲).

General Chou Feng-chi who resides at 146 Rue Pere
Robert is notorious for his treachery against Lu Yung-hsiang
(盧永祥), Tuchun of Chekiang, when he was overthrown by
Sun Chuan Fang and against the latter when the Nationalists
entered Chekiang in 1927. For his desertion of Sun Chuan-
fang the Nationalists appointed him commander of the 26th
Army which occupied Chapei and Paoshan in 1927. He held
this post for about six months when his command was given

从附后的被告供词副本来看，东南自卫军计划于3月13日的某个时刻占领公共安全局及大上海市政府各机关办公室。该军队的核心将由公共安全局成员和商团义勇队组成，为此将向该局代表支付10万美元援助金并提供2,000支步枪，同时保证不对公共安全局现有人员进行解职或变动。新军队组建后，将由周鳳岐将军指挥，据第一主要被告李敏宗（Li Ming-tsoong）供称，该阴谋是以李鰲（Li Ngoh）之名策划的。

居住在罗伯特神父路146号的周鳳岐将军，因其背叛行为而臭名昭著：先是在浙江督军盧永祥被孙传芳推翻时背叛卢，后又在1927年国民革命军进入浙江时背叛孙传芳。因其背弃孙传芳，国民革命军任命他为第二十六军军长，该军于1927年占领了闸北和宝山。他担任此职约六个月，后因蒋介石对其忠诚度表示怀疑，其指挥权被移交

Soong Sih Tseng (宋式璋),
Changsha, Hunan. C.D.I. Robertson.
Lansa Stn. 12/3/30 Clerk: Liao Chun-chien

My name is Soong Sih Tseng (宋式璋), alias Soong Hai-
liang (宋季良). I am 26 years of age and a native of
Changsha, Hunan. I am married and have one son who lives
with my wife at Changsha. I am chief of the Registration
Department of the Kiangnan Arsenal.

At 7 years of age, I commenced my education in a primary
school at Changsha and after studying there for 5 years I
continued my studies in the Ming Teh University at Hankow
which I attended for 8 years studying literature. On
graduating I returned to my native home and stayed there
for 3 years maintaining myself on property left by my
father who died when I was 6 years of age. At the end of
that period I went to Hankow where I obtained employment
as a clerk for 2 years with the Municipal Council of the
Russian Concession. On leaving the employment the Municipality
of the Russian Concession I became chief of the Correspondence
Department of the Hupoh Provincial Bank, Hankow for 6 months
I then took over the position as chief of the First Department
of the Saltpetre and Sulphur Bureau of Hupoh Province at a
salary of $120.00 per mensem which I retained until April
1921. I then returned to my home at Changsha and in July
of the same year I went to Peking in Chekiang to manage
Yang Kwokman which lasted for months. In September 1921
I went to Peking to visit my brother Soong Sih Chen who was
then Vice-Minister of Railways. At the end of November
1921 I came to Shanghai and took up residence at the Shanghai
Railway Station, No. 34 Szechuen Road, Shanghai.

宋式璋 (Soong Sih Tseng)，
湖南长沙。刑侦督察 Robertson。
兰心分局 1930年3月12日 书记员：廖俊健

我叫宋式璋，别名宋季良。我今年26岁，籍贯湖南长沙。我已婚，有一子，与妻子同住长沙。我是江南兵工厂登记处处长。

7岁时，我在长沙的一所小学开始受教育，在那里学习了5年后，我继续在汉口明德大学求学，攻读文学8年。毕业后，我回到家乡，依靠父亲留下的财产生活了3年，父亲在我6岁时去世。期满后，我前往汉口，在俄国租界工部局担任书记员2年。离开俄国租界工部局后，我成为汉口湖北银行通讯处处长，为期6个月。随后，我接任湖北省硝磺局第一处处长的职位，月薪120美元，一直任职至1921年4月。之后我回到长沙家中，同年7月我去浙江北京管理杨国曼（音译）事务，持续了数月。1921年9月，我去北京探望当时任铁道部次长的哥哥宋式珍。1921年11月底，我来到上海，住在上海四川路34号上海火车站。

The following is the statement of Lee Min Tsong (      )

My name is Lee Min Tsong (李敏宗), 29 years of age
and a native of Hu-wei (合肥) Hsien, Anhwei. I am married
and have four children. My wife and family are at my native
place. I studied for a number of years at a private school in
Hu Wei. On attaining the age 21 I came to Shanghai with the
object of visiting a relative named Van Ngoh Ling (范毓麟).
Chief of Staff to General Lu Yung Hsiang (盧永祥). I was
unable to find him so I called on a friend of my father named
General Ching Ngoh Tsang (金佐臣), in General Lu Yung Hsiang's
Army; who lived in the neighbourhood of the Head Post Office.
The exact address I am unable to recall to memory. On the
recommendation of General Ching I proceeded to Canton where I
entered the Whampoa Military Academy. In this institution I
studied infantry manoeuvres for about three months when I was
compelled to discontinue owing to sickness brought on by the
unfavourable climatic conditions. The president of the
academy was General Chiang Kai Shek. I then returned to my
native place and lived with my parents who are still alive.
My father's name is Lee Tsung Yu (李正佑). He is not connected
with any political party and is a principal shareholder in a
steam launch company. Sometime later I went to Wuhu, Anhwei
to enter the employ of the Tuen Li (恒利) Coal Mining Co., as
assistant manager. In this concern my father holds shares
to the amount of $5,000. In this capacity I remained until
1928, when the company suspended operations following the
flooding of the mines and consequent loss caused by further rains.
Whilst in Wuhu I had occasion to visit Shanghai in connection with

以下是由我，刑侦督察 Ross，于1932年3月12日在老闸捕房讯问的安徽籍人士李敏宗的供词，由书记员 Zung 翻译。

我叫李敏宗，29岁，籍贯安徽合肥县。我已婚，有四个孩子。我的妻儿都在老家。我在合肥的一所私塾读了几年书。21岁时，我来到上海，目的是拜访一位名叫范毓麟的亲戚，他是盧永祥将军的参谋长。我没找到他，于是去拜访了我父亲的一位朋友，盧永祥将军部队中的金佐臣将军；他住在邮政总局附近。具体的地址我记不起来了。在金将军的推荐下，我前往广州，进入了黄埔军校。在该校，我学习了约三个月的步兵操演，后因气候条件恶劣导致生病，被迫中断学业。该校校长是蒋介石将军。随后我回到老家，与父母同住，他们尚在人世。我父亲名叫李正佑。他不属于任何政党，是一家轮船公司的主要股东。不久后，我去安徽芜湖，受雇于恒利煤矿公司，担任副经理。在这家公司，我父亲持有价值5,000美元的股份。我在此职位上一直工作到1928年，当时因矿井被淹及后续降雨造成的损失，公司停止运营。在芜湖期间，我曾因

Avenue Joffre, where we rented a room in Tsong's name, for one
day. The date of our arrival in Shanghai, was on the 2nd day
of the 2nd Moon, 1932 (March 8, 1932). During the afternoon of
this date I was loitering on the footpath outside the lodging
house when I observed a kinsman of mine named Lee Ngoh (李夢 )
walking along the same footpath in a westerly direction. I
approached and stopped him and after conversing together on
general matters we entered the lodging house. The last time I
saw Lee was at my native place about 3 years ago, and I had no
idea that he was in Shanghai. At this time Tseong was absent,
he having gone out shopping. I told Lee about my visit to
Chi Tung and my unsuccessful search for employment. After
hearing my story he instructed me to remove to the Wei Tseong
(惠中) hotel on Hankow Road and rent a room there. At the
same time he handed me $100 to meet any expenses I may incur.
I immediately vacated the Toong Chong and went to the Wei
Tseong, but as I was unable to get a room at this place I then
tried the Great Eastern Hotel, where I rented room No.29 at a
rate of $8 per day. Later I also rented room No.34. Both
rooms were registered in my name. After removing from the lodging
house on Avenue Joffre I never saw Tseong Ming again and I believe
that he has returned to Chi Tung. As I could not rent a room at t
the Wei Tseong hotel I chalked a message on the hotel notice
board for the information of Lee Ngoh, who had planned to visit
me, that I had gone to the Great Eastern Hotel. About two hours
after renting room 29 at the Great Eastern Hotel Lee Ngoh
called upon me. He told me about the inefficiency of General
Chiang's government and the necessity of establishing a self
defence force to protect Chinese territory and in this connection
he had received instructions from the Canton government,
authorising him to organise the South Eastern Self Defence Army
(東南自衛軍). Lee also told me that a North Eastern Self
Defence Army (東北自衛軍) had already been organised by Ma
page_data.zh:
-3-
霞飞路（Avenue Joffre），我们以宗（Tsong）的名义租了一个房间，住了一天。我们抵达上海的日期是1932年农历二月初二（1932年3月8日）。当天下午，我在寓所外的人行道上闲逛时，看见我的一个名叫李梦（Lee Ngoh）的亲戚正沿着同一条人行道向西走去。我上前拦住他，在寒暄一番后，我们进入了寓所。我上一次见到李梦是在大约三年前的家乡，我当时并不知道他在上海。此时宗（Tseong）不在，他出去购物了。我告诉李梦我去启东（Chi Tung）以及求职未果的经历。听完我的讲述后，他指示我搬去汉口路的惠中（Wei Tseong）旅馆并在那里租个房间。同时，他递给我100元，以支付我可能产生的任何费用。我立即退掉了通昌（Toong Chong）旅馆的房间前往惠中旅馆，但由于无法在该处租到房间，我便转往大华饭店（Great Eastern Hotel），以每天8元的价格租下了29号房间。后来我又租下了34号房间。这两个房间均以我的名义登记。自从搬离霞飞路的寓所后，我再未见过宗明（Tseong Ming），我相信他已经返回启东。由于我未能租到惠中旅馆的房间，我便在旅馆的公告板上用粉笔留言，告知计划来拜访我的李梦，我已搬至大华饭店。在大华饭店租下29号房间约两小时后，李梦前来拜访。他向我讲述了蒋介石政府效率低下，以及建立自卫力量以保卫中国领土的必要性，并在此方面表示他已收到广州政府的指令，授权他组织东南自卫军。李梦还告诉我，马（Ma）已经组织了东北自卫军

where its headquarters were located. He said that he had been
appointed Commander in Chief of the South Eastern Army but did
not, however, produce any documents regarding his appointment.
He produced two chops one large and one small, bearing the
characters Commander in Chief South Eastern Self Defence Army
(東南自衛軍). Sometimes he left them in a drawer in a table
in the room and at times he took them away with him. Lee visited
me frequently at irregular intervals and on one occasion spent
a night in the room. He brought several paper bundles to the
hotel containing documents relating to letters of appointment
for the posts of officers in the South Eastern Self Defence
Army. He also brought several flags wrapped up in parcels.
He xxxxxxxx did not offer me any appointment but I was hoping
to receive a post as staff officer. He told me to receive callers
to collect mail matter and to allow no strangers to enter the
room and to keep a careful watch on the documents and the
contents of the room. He did not promise me anything in return
for my services and had engaged me simply because I was unemployed.
Among the visitors to room 29 was Wang Ming (王明) the Chief of
the Main Police Squad of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
He only visited this room on one occasion. This was on March 11,
1932. Wong Ming had been appointed commander of the 3rd
Division of the South Eastern Self Defence Army. He told Lee
Egoh and myself that the policemen under his command would be
incorporated in the proposed 3rd Division. When Wong Ming
called he was accompanied by Liang Sung Tien (梁松田), Chief of
the 1st Squad of the Nantao Police, Wong Tseng Sung (王增松)
(in custody), a military training officer of the Great China
University during the past two years, and one Tai Yih Fan (戴一凡)
whose occupation I do not know. Wong Tseng Sung discussed
with Lee Egoh about the transformation of the Nantao Police
into the 3rd Division of the South Eastern Self Defence Army,
after which Lee Egoh left the hotel, giving me instructions to
page_data.zh:
-4-
其总部所在地。他说他已被任命为东南军总司令，但并未出示任何关于其任命的文件。他出示了两颗印章，一大一小，刻有“东南自卫军总司令”字样。有时他将印章留在房间桌子的抽屉里，有时则随身携带。李梦不定期地频繁来访，有一次还在房间里过了一夜。他带了几个纸包到旅馆，里面装有东南自卫军军官委任状的相关文件。他还带来了几面包裹在包裹里的旗帜。他xxxxxxxx没有给我提供任何职位，但我希望能获得一个参谋职务。他让我负责接待访客、收取邮件，不许陌生人进入房间，并仔细看守文件和房间内的物品。他没有承诺因我的服务而给予任何回报，雇用我仅仅是因为我失业。在访问29号房间的访客中，有上海公安局主要警队队长王明（Wang Ming）。他只来过这个房间一次。那是1932年3月11日。王明已被任命为东南自卫军第三师师长。他告诉李梦（Lee Egoh）和我，他麾下的警察将被编入拟议中的第三师。王明来访时，随行的还有南市警察第一队队长梁松田（Liang Sung Tien）、王增松（Wong Tseng Sung）（在押，过去两年在大夏大学担任军事训练教官），以及一名职业不明的戴一凡（Tai Yih Fan）。王增松与李梦讨论了将南市警察改编为东南自卫军第三师的事宜，随后李梦离开旅馆，指示我

page_data.en:
S

entertain ong 'ing and 'ong'□□□□ men to a dinner party.
Nothingparticular was discussed at the subsequent dinner. Lee
Ngoh did not attend.

At 8 a.m. today March 12 Kiang Sung Dau, Yong Zoong
in
Zung (incustody) and Zau Yih Van came to room 34 which was also
opened by me on instructions from Lee Ngoh. Tang Zoong Zang
then came to Room 29 and asked Lee : gah to go to Room 34, but
Lee told me to go on his behalf. I went to Room 34 and asked
Kiang Sung Dau (江声涛) if Tong Hing had made any demands. Kiang
said that he had and then wrote down the following three demands:-
1) Payment of $100,000.
2) Supply of 2,600 rifles.
3) No dismissal or change of the present staff of the Public
Safety Bureau.

I then took the demands and showed them to Lee Ngoh
(李鳌) who was waiting in Room 29. Lee Ngoh wrote the following
reply:-
1) Payment of $50,000 after one week.
2) Supply of 1,600 rifles.
3) Fully accepted.

I handed the answer to Kiang who then demanded that
$10,000 be paid on March 12. Lee Ngoh promised to pay $1,000.
on the afternoon of the same day. At 2 p.m., Kiang Sung Dau,
Yong Zoong Zung (in custody) and Zau Yih Van came to Room 34
Shortly after their arrival, Tseu Ta Sze(谢之大) (in custody),
who had been sent by Lee Ngoh, also came to room 34, and handed
over to Kiang $1,000. Kiang then gave Tseu a receipt for this
amount bearing the signature of Tong Hing. Upon receiving the
money, Kiang told Tseu that Tong Hing would come to see Lee Ngoh
and all Lee's men at 4 p.m. March 12. I was present when the
money was paid but took no part in the transaction.

However, about 3 p.m. the scene was raided by the
police and the occupants, including myself, arrested.
page_data.zh:
S

招待翁明（ong 'ing）和翁□□□□等人参加晚宴。随后的晚宴上没有讨论什么特别的事情。李梦没有出席。

今天上午3月12日8点，江声涛（Kiang Sung Dau）、雍宗正（Yong Zoong Zung，在押）和赵一凡（Zau Yih Van）来到34号房间，该房间也是根据李梦的指示由我打开的。唐宗章（Tang Zoong Zang）随后来到29号房间，叫李梦（Lee : gah）去34号房间，但李梦让我代他前去。我去了34号房间，问江声涛童兴（Tong Hing）是否提出了任何要求。江说提了，然后写下了以下三项要求：
1) 支付10万元。
2) 供应2,600支步枪。
3) 不得解雇或变更公安局现有职员。

随后我拿着这些要求给在29号房间等候的李鳌（Lee Ngoh）看。李鳌写下了以下回复：
1) 一周后支付5万元。
2) 供应1,600支步枪。
3) 完全接受。

我将回复交给江，江随即要求于3月12日支付1万元。李梦答应在同日下午支付1,000元。下午2点，江声涛、雍宗正（在押）和赵一凡来到34号房间。他们到达后不久，李梦派来的谢之大（Tseu Ta Sze，在押）也来到34号房间，并将1,000元交给江。江随后给谢出具了一张带有童兴签名的收据。收到钱后，江告诉谢，童兴将于3月12日下午4点来见李梦及李的所有手下。付款时我在场，但未参与交易过程。

然而，大约在下午3点，警察突袭了现场，包括我在内的所有住客被捕。

page_data.en:
6.

(After the completion of the above, Lee Min Tseung
made the following statement which differs with somewhat
with his original).

Li Min Tseung is my real name and I have never at any
time used any other name.

At the age of 19, I joined the Chekiang Military
School then located at Huchow(湖州), Chekiang. I completed
my course in 6 months and was then appointed Commander of the
5th Battalion of the Chekiang Guerrilla Troops stationed at
Huchow. This post I held for about four months after which
I proceeded to my native place. After staying at home for
about one year, I left for Canton to enter the Whampoa
Military Academy. I remained there about 3 months and then
returned to my native place owing to illness. I stayed
at home until the 16th year of the Republic (1927) when I
came to Shanghai and joined the 26th Army, under General
Chow Feng Chi (周鳳岐) as Commander of the Supplementary Regt.
then stationed in Chapei. I and my troops assisted in
disarming the Labourers' Army in Chapei in 1927.

About June, 1927, General Chow Feng Chi resigned owing
to a divergence of opinion with General Chiang Kai Shek;
I also resigned, and returned to my native place in
Anhui, and engaged in the business I have mentioned in my
previous statement.

I am strongly anti-Communist and I am not a bandit.
Owing to my dissatisfaction with the administrations of the
Nanking Government, I am always anxious to do something to save
my country. So far I know the South Eastern Self Defence Army,
which has just started to be organized, is purely for the
purpose of resisting foreign invasion, and in this connection
I understand that the plan to organize the army is well known
to the commanders of the 19th Route Army, with whom certain
persons are said to have made arrangements.

Lee Min, who is mentioned in my previous statement,
page_data.zh:
6.

（在上述内容完成后，李敏章（Lee Min Tseung）作了如下陈述，与其原始陈述略有不同）。

李敏章是我的真名，我从未在任何时候使用过其他名字。

19岁时，我加入了当时位于浙江湖州（Huchow）的浙江军事学校。我在6个月内完成了课程，随后被任命为驻扎在湖州的浙江游击队第五营营长。我担任此职约四个月后，回到了家乡。在家待了约一年后，我前往广州进入黄埔军校。我在那里待了约3个月，后因生病返回家乡。我在家一直待到民国十六年（1927年），当时我来到上海，加入周凤岐（Chow Feng Chi）将军指挥的第二十六军，担任当时驻扎在闸北的补充团团长。我和我的部队在1927年协助解除了闸北工人纠察队的武装。

1927年6月左右，周凤岐将军因与蒋介石将军意见分歧而辞职；我也随之辞职，回到安徽家乡，从事我在前述陈述中提到的生意。

我强烈反共，我不是匪徒。由于对南京政府的管理不满，我总是渴望做点什么来拯救我的国家。据我所知，刚刚开始组织的东南自卫军纯粹是为了抵抗外国侵略，在此方面，我了解到组织该军队的计划为第十九路军的指挥官们所熟知，据说某些人已与他们达成了安排。

我前述陈述中提到的李敏（Lee Min），

page_data.en:
7.
and Chow Veng Chi are the one and same person.
page_data.zh:
7.
和周凤岐（Chow Veng Chi）是同一个人。

page_data.en:
Li Sing Hgoh (李醒我)。
C.D.I. Robertson.
Chie Ching, Honan
Clerk Liao Chung-chion
Louse Stn. 12/3/32

My name is Li Sing Hgoh (李醒我), alias Li Sau Tseng
(李紹曾), native of Chie Ching; (懷慶) in the province of
Honan. I am 38 years old. I am married and have one son
who is now with my wife in Honan. I am the son of Li Tsun Chin
(李存青), who was a medicine dealer in Hankow and who died 10
years ago. My mother lives at Chie Ching. At 8 years of age,
I commenced my education under a private tutor until I was
19 years old when I obtained an appointment as Liaison Officer
of the 18th Independent Brigade under Tu Fei Fu at Ichang
which I retained until I was 27 years of age. I then secured
an appointment with General Yang Jen (楊森) as officer of the
Administration Department of his forces. I held the latter
position for four years and then went to reside in Hankow for
three years during which time I was unemployed. In the
following year (1928), I was appointed an Inspector of the
Administration Office of the 2nd Special District (Hankow
formerly Russian Concession) of Hankow Municipality. At that
time Sung Shih-piao (宋式鎬), who is now Chief of the
Hanyang Arsenal, was in charge of the Office. About eight
months later that office was abolished and in consequence,
I found myself out of employment but continued to live in
Hankow. In 1930 I was appointed Chief of the Inspection
Office of the Tuh Tang Ping Railway Station (First Station on
the Tsinan Railway to Peking), which position I only
held for four months because the office was abolished by the
Railway Army or the Central while the (□□), was ordered
for transfer to Nanking. At that time Mr. Wang-hung (□□)
page_data.zh:
李醒我（Li Sing Hgoh）。
C.D.I. Robertson.
河南怀庆（Chie Ching, Honan）
职员廖仲权（Liao Chung-chion）
老闸捕房 1932年3月12日

我叫李醒我（Li Sing Hgoh），别名李绍曾（Li Sau Tseng），籍贯河南怀庆（Chie Ching）。我今年38岁。已婚，有一子，现与其母同在河南。我是李存青（Li Tsun Chin）之子，他曾在汉口经营药材生意，于10年前去世。我母亲住在怀庆。我8岁开始跟随私塾老师读书，直到19岁，当时我在宜昌获得了屠非夫（Tu Fei Fu，音译）麾下第十八独立旅联络官的任命，并一直担任该职直到27岁。随后，我在杨森（Yang Jen）将军麾下获得行政部军官的任命。我担任后一职位四年，然后去汉口居住了三年，在此期间我处于失业状态。次年（1928年），我被任命为汉口市第二特区（原汉口俄租界）行政办公室督察。当时，现任汉阳兵工厂厂长的宋式鎬（Sung Shih-piao）负责该办公室。约八个月后，该办公室被撤销，因此我再次失业，但继续居住在汉口。1930年，我被任命为津浦铁路车站（原文如此，括号内注：北京方向津济铁路第一站）稽查处处长，但该职位我只担任了四个月，因为该办公室被铁路军队或中央当局撤销，同时（□□）被命令调往南京。当时，王洪（Wang-hung，□□）先生

page_data.en:
Li Qing Ngoh

- 2 -

Commander of the 25th Division, a former acquaintance, offered
me a position as a military advisor. With the intentions of
seeking the assistance of Soong Sih-piao (宋式善), to find me
a more lucrative position I came to Shanghai at the beginning
of December, 1931, and succeeded in being appointed an
Inspector of the Kiangnan Arsenal at a salary of $80.00 per mensem.
On my arrival in Shanghai I took up residence alone at
No.7 San Teh Fang (三德坊), Rue Chapsal, French Concession.
I still retain my position in the Kiangnan Arsenal and under
the instructions of Soong Sih-piao supervised the removal of the
machinery of the Kiangnan Arsenal to Hangchow. Soong Sih-
piao left for Nanking on the evening of March 11 by the steamer
"Jusih".

On the afternoon of March 11, Tsang Sing-yuan (張鳴遠),
whom I met in Hankow about five years ago and who at that time
was Staff Officer of the 35th Division, under the command of
Chen Ming Shu, came to my home and invited me to dinner at
8.30 p.m. March 12 in the hall of the Great Eastern Hotel and
at the same time he informed me that he would give me a job the
nature of which he did not mention but I understood that it
would be a position in military circles. At 9 a.m., March 12,
Tsang Sing Yuan again came to my home and reminded me of my
appointment and I agreed to go. At 8.30 p.m. I and my friend
Soong Sih-chung, a brother of Soong Sih-piao went by ricksha to
Room No.43 of the Great Eastern Hotel. On entering the room
I was greeted by Tsang Sing-yuan and Tsang Hsiao-tien, who said
page_data.zh:
李清我（Li Qing Ngoh）

- 2 -

第二十五师师长，一位旧识，给我提供了一个军事顾问的职位。为了寻求宋式善（Soong Sih-piao，注：此处与前文宋式鎬名字略有差异，依原文翻译）的帮助以找到一份更丰厚的职位，我于1931年12月初来到上海，并成功被任命为江南兵工厂督察，月薪80.00元。抵达上海后，我独自居住在法租界查佩尔路（Rue Chapsal，即今淡水路）三德坊7号。我仍保留在江南兵工厂的职位，并根据宋式善的指示，监督江南兵工厂机器设备迁往杭州的工作。宋式善于3月11日晚乘“Jusih”号轮船前往南京。

3月11日下午，张鸣远（Tsang Sing-yuan）来到我家，我约五年前在汉口认识他，当时他是陈铭枢指挥的第三十五师参谋。他邀请我于3月12日晚上8点30分在大华饭店大厅共进晚餐，同时他告诉我他会给我一份工作，但未提及工作性质，我理解那将是军界的一个职位。3月12日上午9点，张鸣远再次来到我家，提醒我赴约，我同意前往。晚上8点30分，我和我的朋友宋式中（Soong Sih-chung，宋式善的兄弟）乘人力车前往大华饭店43号房间。进入房间后，张鸣远和张孝天（Tsang Hsiao-tien）迎接了我，他们说

page_data.en:
Li Sing Ngoh

- 3 -

named two men were introduced to me by Tsang Ming Yuen.
Shortly afterwards we five men went to the ground floor of
the hotel have tiffin. During the tiffin Tsang Ming Yuen
and Li Ming Soong said we are going to organize an army
and requested the help of the remainder of the company. They
further stated that the proposed army would assist the 19th
Route Army to resist Japan. After further unimportant
conversation we all left the dining room and went upstairs
to the same floor where we entered another room the number
of which I do not know. On entering the room Tsang Ming
Yuen and Li Ming Soong asked the boy to serve tea and
cigarettes. While this was being done a man dressed in
a khaki uniform jacket (Wang Zoong Zung (王仲仁)) came in
and said to Li Ming Soong "Our men are coming" and then left.
The police arrived immediately afterwards and arrested every
one in the room.
page_data.zh:
李醒我（Li Sing Ngoh）

- 3 -

张鸣远向我介绍了两名男子。不久之后，我们五人下楼到酒店底层吃便饭。用餐期间，张鸣远和李明松（Li Ming Soong）说我们要组织一支军队，并请求在座其他人的帮助。他们进一步表示，拟议中的军队将协助第十九路军抗日。经过一些无关紧要的交谈后，我们都离开了餐厅，上楼回到同一楼层，进入了另一个房间，房号我不清楚。进入房间后，张鸣远和李明松让侍者送上茶和香烟。就在这一过程中，一名身穿卡其色制服上衣的男子（王仲仁，Wang Zoong Zung）走进来，对李明松说：“我们的人来了”，然后离开。警察随即赶到，逮捕了房间内的所有人。

page_data.en:
Chou Taz-zah
Chekiang (Supt. Robertson)
9 p.m. March 15 J.I. Sih Ts Liang

My name is Chou Taz-zah. I am 29 years of age, native
of Chekiang, and reside in room 33 Dah Zung lodging house,
Route Chapel, French Concession. I graduated from the Jen
Chi University, Kiangsu, in 1926 and went to Kiukiang where
I was employed as postal and telegraph censor by the Kiukiang
Defence Commissioner's Headquarters. I held this post for
three months at the end of which period the Defence Com-
missioner and his troops moved to Chuchow, Chekiang, where
they were reorganized and styled the 26th Revolutionary Army,
commanded by General Chen Feng-shi. I was appointed officer-
in-charge of the Telegraph Section of this army. In February
1927 the army arrived in Shanghai where I maintained my
position until October of the same year following the
resignation of Chen Feng-shi. I then went to Foochow and
and there was appointed Chief Detective to the Salt
Transportation Bureau. I held this post until March 1928
when I resigned following the Chief of the Bureau, Ying S
Li (殷世禮) giving up his appointment. I came to Shanghai
where I remained without employment until June 1929 when I
was asked by Chang Ting-fan through my friend named Zak Leung
Fong (石力峰) who formerly served as a Battalion Commander
under Chang Ting-fan, to assist him. Chang Ting-fan in the
capacity of a secret representative of Li Tsung-jen in
Shanghai, opposed Chiang Kai-shek's dictatorship. This work
ceased one month later when Chang Ting-fan left for Canton.
From April to October 1930 I assisted Chang Tung-yu (張東宇)
and Lee Sing-yu (李定遠) secret representatives of Wang
page_data.zh:
周达扎（音译）
浙江籍（罗伯逊警司）
3月15日晚9时 J.I. Sih Ts Liang

我叫周达扎（音译）。现年29岁，浙江人，居住在法租界霞飞路大钟旅馆33号房间。我于1926年毕业于江苏仁济大学，随后前往九江，在九江防卫专员公署担任邮电检查员。我在该职位上任职三个月，期满后，防卫专员及其部队移驻浙江衢州，在那里进行整编，改称为第二十六革命军，由陈凤石将军指挥。我被任命为该军电报科负责人。1927年2月，该军抵达上海，我一直保持该职位直至同年10月陈凤石辞职。随后我前往福州，被任命为盐务运输局首席侦探。我担任此职直至1928年3月，因局长殷世禮放弃任命而辞职。我来到上海，一直失业至1929年6月，当时张廷藩通过我的朋友石力峰（原名Zak Leung Fong，音译）请求我协助他，石力峰曾任张廷藩麾下的营长。张廷藩作为李宗仁在上海的秘密代表，反对蒋介石的独裁统治。一个月后张廷藩前往广州，这项工作便停止了。从1930年4月至10月，我协助汪精卫在上海的秘密代表张东宇和李定远

page_data.en:
2

Yu-hsiang, in Shanghai, in conducting an anti-Chiang Kai-shek
movement. My assistance consisted of writing letters,
deciphering codes and negotiating with the Shanghai
representative of the Canton army. These efforts were
without success. From October 1930 until the present I have
had no employment, depending upon my relatives for my upkeep.
My father is Chen Fah-tsing ( 周福清 ), manager of the Hang T
Tsang Cotton Mill, Hankow Road. He, my father, and all my
relatives are in Hangchow, where they went at the commence-
ment of the Sino-Japanese hostilities. I have been offered
a post as City Magistrate by the Chekiang Provincial
Government but I have declined owing to my heart being weak.
In 1937 I met Li Hsing-tseeng ( 李振聲 ) at a dinner
party given by a friend when Li claimed to be a commander
of the 3rd Division of the 87th Army. Following that
occasion we met several times and the acquaintanceship
seemed to drop as we saw nothing of each other. On the
morning of 7th of this month he sent a coolie to my home
asking me to go to the Tung Chang lodging house, Avenue
Joffre, near Rue Chaponl. No reason was given for the
request. I thought the request a little strange but
nevertheless I went to the Tung Chang lodging house the same
day at about 10 a.m. and met Li Hsing-tseeng alone when he
told me that arrangements had been made whereby the Reserve
Unit of the Bureau of Public Safety would come under the
orders of one Li Hsun ( 李勳 ) as a preliminary step to
organizing a Self-Defence Army. I do not know who Li Hsun
page_data.zh:
2

开展反蒋介石运动。我的协助工作包括写信、破译密码以及与粤军上海代表进行谈判。这些努力均未成功。从1930年10月至今，我一直没有工作，依靠亲属供养。我的父亲是周福清（原文注：Chen Fah-tsing），汉口路恒泰纱厂经理。他和我的所有亲属都在杭州，中日战事爆发之初他们便去了那里。浙江省政府曾向我提供县长一职，但我因心脏虚弱而拒绝。1937年，我在一次朋友举办的晚宴上遇见李振声（原文注：Li Hsing-tseeng），李自称是第八十七师第三师师长。那次之后我们又见过几次面，但由于彼此不再见面，这段交情似乎就淡了。本月7日上午，他派一名苦力到我家，叫我去霞飞路近沙盆尼路（Rue Chaponl）的东昌旅馆。请求中未说明原因。我觉得这个请求有点奇怪，但还是于当天上午10点左右去了东昌旅馆，单独见到了李振声，他告诉我，已作出安排，保安局后备队将归李勳指挥，作为组建自卫军的初步步骤。我不知道李勳

page_data.en:
3

is. I did not ask Li Ming-tsung who he, Li Agauh, was as
the matter was strictly secret. Li Ming-tsung told me that
he wanted the service of people with diplomatic qualifications
to assist in establishing understanding with the local
representatives of the Foreign Powers. I promised to find
such a person for him. I then went (on March 8) to see
General Chou Feng-chi at 146 Rue Pere Robert and explained
the matter to him, telling him what I wanted. General Chou
appeared to be acquainted with the gist so he never put any
questions to me. I went to General Chou Feng-chi's house
again on the morning of March 9 when General Chou said he had
seen Wellington Koo who sympathises with the aim of an army
composed of merchant volunteers and police to defend Nantao
as the Japanese would not attack such a force in that it would
not be termed military. On the morning of March 10 Li Ming-
tsung again sent his coolie to my lodgings informing me that he
had removed to the Great Eastern Hotel. I went there the same
day at 9 a.m. when I saw Li Ming-tsung who introduced me to
two others in his room. These men were named Shen Tseh-chou
(武暉初), a training officer of the Bureau of Public
Safety, and Wang Ling (王麟), a military training officer
of the Great China University. I informed them of General
Chou's interview with Mr. Wellington Koo whereupon Shen
expressed his willingness to carry on the organisation of the
proposed army. I then withdrew as I thought they wanted to
discuss secret military matters. I then went to the home of
General Chou Feng-chi to inform him that Li Ming-tsung had
page_data.zh:
3

是谁。我没有问李明宗（音译，原文此处为Li Ming-tsung，前文为Li Hsing-tseeng，似指同一人或相关人，依上下文译为李明宗或保留关联）李阿高（音译，Li Agauh）是谁，因为此事严格保密。李明宗告诉我，他需要具有外交资格的人士服务，以帮助与外国势力在当地代表建立谅解。我答应为他寻找这样的人选。随后我（于3月8日）去罗伯特神父路146号见周凤岐将军，向他解释了此事，告诉了他我的意图。周将军似乎知晓大意，因此没有问我任何问题。3月9日上午，我再次前往周凤岐将军府邸，周将军说他会见了顾维钧，顾维钧对由商团志愿者和警察组成军队保卫南市的宗旨表示同情，因为日军不会攻击这样一支不被视为军事力量的部队。3月10日上午，李明宗再次派苦力到我的住处，通知我他已搬至大华饭店。我于当天上午9点到达那里，见到李明宗，他向我介绍了房间里的另外两人。这两人是武暉初（原文注：Shen Tseh-chou），保安局训练官，和王麟，大夏大学军事训练官。我向他们通报了周将军与顾维钧先生会面的情况，随后武表示愿意继续组织拟议中的军队。我认为他们要讨论秘密军事事务，便退出了。随后我前往周凤岐将军家中，告知他李明宗已

page_data.en:
4
decided to put his plans for the organization of a defence
army into execution.
On March 11 (at 5.30 p.m.) I went to the Great
Eastern Hotel where I saw Li Ming-tseng who introduced me
to Huang Hing, Chief of the Reserve Unit of the Public
Safety Bureau. Huang Hing expressed his desire to be
appointed Divisional Commander having sole control over the
Public Safety Bureau to which Li Ming-tseng agreed on the
condition that by the night of March 12 the Defence Army
should be formally established and that the flags of the
Army be hoisted at Nantao. Huang Hing promised to give
an answer personally at 9 a.m. March 12. In the room there
were two others; one was Feng Ling and the other named Zao,
brought by Huang Hing. I left at 8.30 p.m. while the four
persons were taking dinner. Li Ming-tseng told me he was in the
employ of one Li Yuen. Li Ming-tseng did not say who Li
Yuen was or what remuneration he, Li Ming-tseng, would
receive.
At 9.45 a.m. March 12 I went to the Great Eastern
Hotel and found Li Ming-tseng, Feng Ling, Zao and another
Chinese whom he introduced to me under the name Kiang Sung-
tso (江声涛) as Group Commander of the Reserve Unit, the
latter two representing Huang Hing. Li then told me that
Huang Hing had sent these two representatives here and
demanded $100,000.00, 2,000 rifles and free appointment for
himself in the unit of division under him, that he had agreed
to give 1,500 rifles and pay $50,000 respectively in ten or
page_data.zh:
4
决定将其组建防御军的计划付诸实施。
3月11日（下午5时30分），我前往大华饭店，见到李明宗（原文此处拼写为Li Ming-tseng），他把我介绍给黄兴，保安局后备队队长。黄兴表示希望被任命为师长，独家控制保安局，李明宗同意了这一要求，条件是国防军必须在3月12日晚之前正式成立，并在南市升起军旗。黄兴答应在3月12日上午9点亲自给予答复。房间里还有另外两人；一个是冯玲（音译，Feng Ling），另一个姓赵，由黄兴带来。晚上8时30分，当这四个人正在吃晚饭时，我离开了。李明宗告诉我他受雇于一位李元（音译，Li Yuen）。李明宗没有说李元是谁，也没有说他自己将获得多少报酬。
3月12日上午9时45分，我前往大华饭店，见到李明宗、冯玲、赵某以及另一位中国人，他向我介绍此人为江声涛，后备队大队长，后两人代表黄兴。李随后告诉我，黄兴派了这两位代表来这里，索要10万美元、2,000支步枪，并为其麾下师级单位争取自由任命权，李同意给予1,500支步枪，并在该军成立后的十或

page_data.en:
5
seven days time after the inauguration of this army, and free
me confirming these conditions and another
appointment. Meanwhile I saw Li holding a paper slip containing
an item indicating that $100,000 as reserve and expenses would
be given to Huang immediately on the day following the
inauguration of the army. These two slips were subsequently
handed to Kiang Sung-tao. Li further instructed them to ask
Huang Hsing whether he accepted these conditions or not,
whereupon Kiang intimated that Huang would most probably
accept them, but to defray the expenses in starting the
movement at 9 p.m. March 12. Kiang demanded that $5,000
be issued to them at once. Li Ming-tseng agreed to pay
$3,000 but asked them to consult with Huang Hing first,
whereupon Kiang Sung-tao and Wang Ling left with the two chits,
while I remained in the hotel. Li Ming-tseng having no money,
consulted with me and in consequence I proceeded to Chen Fung-ai
chi's home where I arrived at 10.30 a.m. I explained to
Chen the situation and Chen promised to apply to Mr. Kee for
assistance and instructed me to return for reply an hour later.
After having spent an hour in visiting friends, I returned to
Chen's home. Chen gave me $3,000 in notes which he said was
obtained from Mr. Kee. I brought the $3,000 to Great Eastern
Hotel where I reached at about 11.45 a.m. I saw Li Ming-tseng
in Room 20. Then he told me that Huang Hing had agreed and
I told him that $3,000 had been brought here; I then handed
the money to him, whereupon we went to Room 34 where I found
that Huang and Wang had both returned, Huang bringing him with
small leather case. Li Ming-tseng then handed the money to
page_data.zh:
5
七天内分别支付5万美元，并免除
我确认这些条件及另一项任命。同时，我看到李拿着一张纸条，上面有一项内容表明，在军队成立后的第二天，将立即向黄提供10万美元作为储备金和经费。这两张纸条随后交给了江声涛（原文此处拼写为Kiang Sung-tao）。李进一步指示他们去询问黄兴是否接受这些条件，江暗示黄很可能会接受，但要求在3月12日晚上9点支付启动运动的经费。江要求立即向他们发放5,000美元。李明宗同意支付3,000美元，但要求他们先与黄兴商量，随后江声涛和王麟带着两张便条离开，而我留在酒店。李明宗没有钱，与我商量，因此我前往陈凤爱奇（音译，Chen Fung-ai chi，疑为前文周福清或周凤岐之误，依音译处理）家中，于上午10时30分到达。我向陈说明了情况，陈答应向基先生（Mr. Kee）求助，并 instruct 我一小时后回来听回复。在拜访朋友度过一小时后，我回到陈家。陈给了我3,000元钞票，他说这是从基先生那里得来的。我带着这3,000元来到大华饭店，于上午11时45分左右到达。我在20号房间见到了李明宗。然后他告诉我黄兴已经同意，我告诉他带来了3,000元；随后我把钱交给他，于是我们去了34号房间，我发现黄和王都已回来，黄带给他一个小皮箱。李明宗随后把钱交给

page_data.en:
6

Kiang Jung-tae who placed the notes on a table. While he
was placing the notes into a leather case, Joe had a rough check
of the notes. Li then in the presence of Kiang and others,
handed me the receipt of 3,000 as food money for the
Division signed by Huang Ming. Subsequently Kiang announced
that Wang Wing would come at 4 p.m. the same day to have a last
discussion on the matter and to fix the time for the starting
of this movement. (Kiang, Joe and Tang Ming then left.
I remained and took tiffin in the Dining Room with Li, one
unknown person, and one Chang Ming Yuen, whom I knew on my
visit to the Grand Modern Hotel, through the introduction of
Li who described him as Chief of Staff. I do not know when
he entered this room. I returned to Room 34 at 4 p.m. with a
view to learning the result of coming discussion by Huang Ming
and found Li Hing-cheong and Joe and two unknown persons, one
of whom was writing. I then asked Li whether Huang had come
or not. Li did not give a clear reply. A few moments later
Joe left. I then informed Li of a report to the effect that
the Chinese authorities would take special precautions to-night
for they had received information about possible uprising by
agitators. Just at that time Chinese and foreign
policemen, armed with pistols, entered us. They searched
our persons and the room.
