page_data.en:
Tsiang Ming-tsih (蔣明柱)
Szechuen                                      D.S.Golder 118
2 p.m.                19/3/32                 C.D.S.I.Huang

My name is Tsiang King-tsih (蔣明柱), native of Yin Yang
Hsian (雲陽), Szechuen. I am aged 58 years and married
to Tsiang Tsang Sse, also a native of Szechuen, who is
at present staying in my native place.
    I first went to School at the age of 8 years, when I
entered a family school in my native place continuing my
education there until the age of 18. At the age of 18 years
I took an examination, passed and became a scholar under
the Seu-Zai (Foreign Knowledge) system which was introduced
during the Ching Dynasty. I studied under a tutor in my
native place until I was 28 years of age, when I proceeded
to Peking and there took an examination at the 2nd Imperial
Academy. On passing this examination I was selected to
become a civil officer under the Imperial Government. I
remained in Peking for a period of about 6 years altogether
and then was sent to Soochow where I took over the post of
President of the Judicial Yuan. I actually took over the
office in 1910 one year before the revolution. At the
outbreak of the revolution I took up the post of secretary
to Sung Teh-chuan (程德全) who was that time a "President
of the Kiangsu Province". I proceeded with him to the
attack on Nanking which took place on 18th day of the 8th
moon 1911. The siege of Nanking lasted about one month
when the holders gave in. With the fall of Nanking I
left the employment of Sung Teh-chuan and entered the
service of Dr. Sun Yat-sen who had been elected temporary
President and had established his office in Nanking which
page_data.zh:
蒋明柱 (Tsiang Ming-tsih)
四川                                      D.S.Golder 118
下午2时                1932年3月19日                 C.D.S.I.Huang

本人名为蒋明柱 (Tsiang King-tsih)，籍贯四川云阳县 (Yin Yang Hsian)。现年58岁，已婚，妻子为蒋藏氏 (Tsiang Tsang Sse)，亦系四川人，目前居住在本人原籍。
    本人8岁开始入学，在家乡入私塾读书，直至18岁。18岁时参加科举考试，及格后成为清朝引入的“西学” (Seu-Zai，即外国知识) 体系下的生员。本人在家乡跟随导师学习至28岁，随后前往北京，在第二高等学堂参加考试。通过该考试后，被选拔为清政府文官。本人在北京总共停留约6年，随后被派往苏州，接任司法院院长一职。本人实际上于1910年就职，即革命前一年。革命爆发时，本人担任程德全 (Sung Teh-chuan) 的秘书，程当时任“江苏省都督”。本人随他参加1911年农历八月十八日发生的南京攻坚战。南京围城战持续约一个月，守军投降。随着南京陷落，本人离开程德全麾下，投效当选为临时大总统并在南京（被选为临时首都）设立办公处的孙中山博士。

page_data.en:
-2-
city had been chosen as the temporary capital. About one
year after taking office as temporary president Dr. Sun Yat-
sen handed over office to Li Yuan-hung (黎元洪) who had been
selected as the first president and who had established his
government at Peking. With the formation of the new govern-
ment I left the services of Dr. Sun-Yat-sen and went to
Peking, entering the services of Li Yuan-hung as his secre-
tary and Political advisor. When Li Yuan hung completed
his term of office, I entered the service of Yuan Shih-kai
(袁世凯) who succeeded him. I remained in the employ of
Yuan Shih-kai (袁世凯) as secretary and political advisor
until his death, at which I took service in the same
capacity with Feng Kuo-tsang (馮國璋). Feng's death
occurred about one year after he took office I therefore
entered the services of Hsu Shih-tsang, who was the next
after being in office 2 years Hsu Shih-tsang resigned
president. I did likewise and returned to my native
place in Szechuen. After being at home for a short period
I re-entered the service of the Republic and took up the
work as advisor to the offices of the ministries of finance
Education etc. During this period I paid numerous visits
to my native place. I finally left the service of the
government in 1929 when I made my last trip to Peking.
Soon after my resignation I went to Szechuen and remained
there for about two years during which time I prepared
manuscripts for books on politics, economics, philosophy
and law. I completed my work on the books by the end of 1930.
I left Szechuen in April, and proceeded to Nanking as
page_data.zh:
-2-
孙中山博士就任临时大总统约一年后，将职位移交给被选为首任总统并在北京建立政府的黎元洪 (Li Yuan-hung)。随着新政府的成立，本人离开孙中山博士麾下，前往北京，作为秘书和政治顾问投效黎元洪。当黎元洪任期届满后，本人投效继任者袁世凯 (Yuan Shih-kai)。本人一直担任袁世凯的秘书和政治顾问，直至其去世，随后以同样身份受雇于冯国璋 (Feng Kuo-tsang)。冯国璋就职约一年后去世，因此本人转投徐世昌麾下。徐世昌就职两年后辞去总统职务。本人亦随之辞职，返回四川原籍。在家短暂停留后，本人重新效力于民国政府，担任财政部、教育部等部委的顾问。在此期间，本人多次返回原籍。本人最终于1929年最后一次前往北京后辞去政府职务。辞职后不久，本人前往四川，在那里停留约两年，期间撰写了关于政治、经济、哲学和法律的书稿。本人于1930年底完成著书工作。
本人于四月离开四川，应甘肃第四路军指挥官史宗鲁 (Shih Tsung-loo) 之邀，前往南京

page_data.en:
-3-
the instance of Shih Tsung-loo (史宗魯), Commander of
the 4th Route Army in Kansu to apply to the Nanking Govern-
ment for funds for the 4th Route Army. I went to the
Military Headquarters where I made application to General
Chu Pei-teh (朱培德), Chief of Staff. The application was
accepted but the funds at the time had not been raised.
Ten days later after my arrival in Nanking I was arrested
by the Nanking Garrison Commander's Headquarters on the
charge of fabricating rumours, starting agitation, and
conducting subversive correspondence in a secret code and
an attempted Coup d'Etat against General Hsueh Yueh-tung
(薛岳棟) of the 20th Army Corps in Hupeh. I was detained
in headquarters of the Garrison Commander for about 4 months
On my release I took up residence in Nanking, remaining
there for about 1 month, then came to Shanghai arriving
here on November 23, 1931. I took a room in the Far
Eastern Hotel and later moved to the Goei Loh Hotel on Thibet
Road. Later in the month of January I moved to my friend's
house in the Chih Wei Li, No.744, Seymour Road. My friend
Tsang Tse-syng (張樹声) who resides at this address is
assistant to the Commander of the Kiangsu Bandit Suppression
Corps. Tsang told me that I could have a room on the
ground floor of no.744 Chih Wei Li, Seymour Road. Soon
after the start of the Sino-Japanese Hostilities in
Shanghai I went to see U. Yamamoto at the Palace Hotel,
Room 129 and asked him to render me some assistance in
getting some of my friends out of the Chapel area.
page_data.zh:
-3-
向南京政府申请第四路军经费。本人前往军事总部，向参谋长朱培德 (Chu Pei-teh) 将军提出申请。申请虽被接受，但当时款项尚未筹集。抵达南京十天后，本人被南京卫戍司令部逮捕，罪名是制造谣言、煽动闹事、使用密码进行颠覆性通信，以及企图对驻湖北的第二十军薛岳栋 (Hsueh Yueh-tung) 将军发动政变。本人被拘押在卫戍司令总部约4个月。获释后，本人在南京居住，停留约1个月，随后来到上海，于1931年11月23日抵达此地。本人先在远东饭店租了一间房，后搬至西藏路的戈威洛酒店 (Goei Loh Hotel)。同年一月下旬，本人搬至西摩路744号慈惠里朋友家中。住在此地址的朋友张树声 (Tsang Tse-syng) 是江苏剿匪指挥部指挥官的助理。张树声告诉本人，可以使用西摩路744号慈惠里底楼的一间房。上海中日敌对行动开始后不久，本人前往华懋饭店129室会见山本 (U. Yamamoto)，请他协助将本人的一些朋友从闸北地区撤出。

page_data.en:
-4-
All my dealings with Japanese have been for the same
purpose.
Hitherto I have omitted to state that about 19 years
I was superintendent in charge of Chinese students in
Japan and whilst there I made a number of Japanese friends.
page_data.zh:
-4-
本人与日本人的所有交往均出于同一目的。
此前本人未提及，约19年前，本人曾担任留日中国学生监督，在此期间结识了许多日本朋友。

page_data.en:
(1)

Translation of document seized during a raid on
the home of Tsiang Mingjih, 744 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road at 12 noon March 19, 1932.

---

Ming,

I am very glad to hear that Tsou Sung will
proceed to Hupeh and I hold the following opinion :

1. As the matter according to Sun Ah-deu (? Sun Fo)
will be announced at a time when everything had
been properly arranged and it is believed that the
"Straw Head General" (Chiang Kai-shek) will not
meddle with it. Will you advise Tsing not to
worry any more. He (? Tsou Sung)) will go to
Nanking to exert all his energy to assist in
accomplishing the matter.

2. As regard Mo Nghi's (Feng) case, the official
circle exerts every effort to prove that it is
groundless. Have you heard any evidence regarding
the same?

3. As there is assistance from the Interior, the
situation will not be affected and as the
influence of the bandits will be intensified during the
present national crisis in Hupeh, it is very needful
to have a stable commander. The present unsettled
situation will profit a wise person who can pick up
an excellent chance through it.

(Sd.) Han Ts-ching

---

Envelope: Chiang Kai.,
Mingjih
c/o 744 Shih Wei Li, Seymour Road.

Awaiting reply. From Zing Ming.

(1)

1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明极 (Tsiang Mingjih) 住所搜查期间缴获文件的译文。

---

明：

获悉邹松 (Tsou Sung) 将前往湖北，甚感欣慰，本人持有以下意见：

1. 据孙阿斗 (? 孙科 Sun Fo) 称，此事将在一切安排妥当后公布，相信“草头将军” (蒋介石) 不会插手。请劝告青 (Tsing) 不必再担忧。他 (? 邹松) 将前往南京，竭尽全力协助促成此事。

2. 关于莫疑 (Mo Nghi，即冯) 一案，官方圈子正竭力证明其毫无根据。你是否听到有关此事的任何证据？

3. 由于有内部援助，局势不会受到影响；鉴于当前国家危机期间湖北匪患影响加剧，非常需要一位稳定的指挥官。目前的动荡局势有利于智者从中捕捉绝佳机会。

(签名) 韩佐清 (Han Ts-ching)

---

信封：蒋介.,
明极
转交 西摩路慈惠里744号。

等候回复。来自青明 (Zing Ming)。

page_data.en:
2

Translation of document seized during a raid on
the home of Tsiang Ming-chih, 844 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road, at 12 noon, March 19, 1932.

---

December 31
Mr. Ming Jih,

My friend Liu Ching-san's men have
about 5,000 rifles and are at present distributed
on the border of Kiangsu and Shantung. I request
you to try to find some one in Shanghai to collect
them and organize them, whereby we can make a
fundamental force out of them with a view to
completing the Chinese Revolution. It will be
best to have a discussion with your Assistant.
Hoping that you will favour me with a reply,

Yours faithfully,

Chang Chi-ming.

P.S. In 1924 Sun Yat-sen appointed Liu as Commander
of the 11th Army. During the Northern Punitive
Drive, he was appointed by Chiang as Commander-
in-Chief of the Kiao Tung People Group and at
present acts as Major General Military Adviser.
Li Chi-sen is at present Director of Military
Training; have you any connection with him and
can you introduce me to him?
page_data.zh:
2

1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路慈惠里844号蒋明之 (Tsiang Ming-chih) 住所搜查期间缴获文件的译文。

---

12月31日
明极先生：

我的朋友刘景三 (Liu Ching-san) 的部下拥有约5,000支步枪，目前分布在江苏和山东边境。请你尝试在上海找人收集并整编这些武器，以便我们将他们组建为一支基本力量，以完成中国革命。最好与你的助理商议。
盼复，

此致
敬礼，

张济明 (Chang Chi-ming)。

附言：1924年，孙中山任命刘为第十一军军长。在北伐期间，他被蒋介石任命为胶东人民集团总指挥，目前担任少将军事顾问。李济深 (Li Chi-sen) 目前担任军事训练总监；你与他是否有联系，能否将我引荐给他？

page_data.en:
Translation of document seized during a raid on the
home of Tsiang Ming-chih (蔣明極), 744 Shih Wei
Li, Seymour Road, at 12 noon, March 19, 1932.

--

December 21,

Minister Shigemitsu,

I beg to inform you that I arrived
in Shanghai yesterday and would like to have an interview
with you. If you have time, I shall come to you and
have a hearty talk with you. Besides I have some
important affairs to discuss with you.

Yours faithfully,
Sd. Chiang Zu-lih
(alias Ming Jih)

P.S. I appreciate your introduction to me last year
of Consul Shang Tsuan (上村) who had several
negotiations with me which resulted in satisfaction.
I met brethren Pai Kong (北岡), Dien Chung (田中),
Chung Tsing (村井) yesterday. I told them to
convey the matter to you and I believe that they have
dealt it with you already. I hope that you will appoint
a date for an interview.

(Note: The last three names mentioned in P.S. are
all Japanese).
page_data.zh:
1932年3月19日中午12时，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明极 (Tsiang Ming-chih，原文注：蔣明極) 住所搜查期间缴获文件的译文。

--

12月21日，

重光公使阁下：

谨告知阁下，本人昨日抵达上海，希望能与阁下会面。若阁下有暇，本人将登门拜访，与阁下畅谈。此外，本人还有一些重要事务需与阁下商讨。

此致
敬礼，
签名：蒋祖礼 (Chiang Zu-lih)
(别名：明极 Ming Jih)

附言：感谢阁下去年将我引荐给上村 (Shang Tsuan) 领事，他与本人进行了数次谈判，结果令人满意。本人昨日会见了北冈 (Pai Kong)、田中 (Dien Chung)、村井 (Chung Tsing) 诸位同仁。本人已托他们将此事转达给阁下，相信他们已与阁下接洽。希望阁下能约定会面日期。

(注：附言中提到的最后三个名字均为日本人)。

December 24,

Mr. Min Tsih,

Shigemitsu

(慈惠里), Seymour Road, at 12 noon March 19, 1932.

........

February 18.

Commander-in-Chief Uyeda,

It is three years since we saw you last;
have you an idea about the hearty talk and joking beside
the sea among us and Chuen Be (南池) (Chief of Staff),
San Ya (三野) (Staff Officer), Chih Dien (吉田 )
(Interpreter and Adviser), when you were in command at
Tientsin and Taku. This time you came to Shanghai and
I too owing to some important affairs have arrived here.
I originally intended to have an interview with you,
but am not in position to do so due to my present
engagement. Therefore I have to write to you to
offer my good wishes. I am at present engaged in
the peace movement; you can get important particulars
from Dien Chung (田中 ), Fei Kong (北岡 ) Chun Tsing
(村井 ), and Kiang Gee (江崎 ) (all names of
Japanese).

As regards whether there is hope for peace and
other measures, please tell me through Brother Dian
Chung (田中 )

Yours faithfully,
Have an attached card.

P.S. The intimate friendship between the two nations
should be based on the people. Your Army is
famous for its civility; I hope that it will
not treat the people in a brutal manner, but will
be merciful towards them.

2月18日。

植田（Uyeda）司令官阁下：

自上次拜别，已历三载；不知阁下是否还记得，当您在天津和大沽指挥期间，我们与您以及南池（Chuen Be）（参谋长）、三野（San Ya）（参谋）、吉田（Chih Dien）（翻译兼顾问）在海边畅谈欢谑的情景。此次您来到上海，我也因要务在身抵达此地。我原本打算拜访您，但因目前事务缠身，无法成行。因此特致函向您致以问候。我目前从事和平运动；您可以从田中（Dien Chung）、北冈（Fei Kong）、村井（Chun Tsing）和江崎（Kiang Gee）（均为日本人姓名）处获悉重要详情。

关于和平是否有望及其他措施，请通过田中（Dian Chung）兄告知我。

此致
敬礼
附名片一张。

又及：两国之亲密友谊应建立在民众基础之上。贵军以文明著称；我希望贵军不要粗暴对待民众，而应对他们施以仁慈。

Brother Hung.

the home of Tsiang Ming Jih, No.744 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road at noon on March 19th, 1932.

Kuo, Commander of the 26th Division of the National Army,
According to the No.204 letter of the Garrison
Commander's Headquarters'of Hankow, during the inspection
of postal matters they discovered a Japanese telegram
entitled "Telegram from the Song Dau (Japanese) Consul-
General at Tientsin to the Acting Consul-General Shigimitsu
of Shanghai" in company with a paper written according to
a secret code in a roll of mosquito paper sent to Tsiang
Ming Jih, Sing Hwa Hotel, Nanking, from Hankow and that
these documents are fabricating rumours, starting agitation
communicating under a secret code and of a rebellious character
and we are requested to arrest the person in order to
prevent possible embarassment. In accordance with this
we have arrested one Tsiang Ming Jih and seized a number
of documents of a rebellious nature including several
letters from Chiang Soo, 43 Yung Tsing Tsung Road, Hankow,
to Tsiang Ming Jih, and Ling Ching Dai, in connection
with a proposed coup d'etat against Kuo. Accordingly
we replied Au (夏), the Garrison Commander of Hankow
by telegram and requested him to arrest the accomplice.
In answer to this we were later informed by the afore-
mentioned Authorities that one Chiang Soo had been arrest-
ed, who stated that he is engaged as an advisor of the
26th Division and undertook the activities of overthrow-
ing Kuo and they also asked if itis all right to send
these accused Tsiang Ming Jih and Chiang Soo to your
Division for investigation. Regarding this we would
like to get a reply from you.
Attached herewith is a copy of the original letter
from the Garrison Commander's Headquarters, the Japanese
telegram with translation and three letters written by
Chiang S...

1932年3月19日中午，在西摩路慈惠里744号蒋明日（Tsiang Ming Jih）寓所突袭行动中发现的文件译文。

致国民革命军第二十六师师长郭：

据汉口卫戍司令部第204号函称，在检查邮政事务期间，他们发现一卷寄往南京新华饭店蒋明日的蚊香纸中，夹有一份题为“驻天津日本总领事松道（Song Dau）（日本人）致上海代理总领事重光（Shigimitsu）的电报”的日本电报，以及一份用密码书写的文件，这些文件制造谣言、煽动骚乱、使用密码通讯，具有叛乱性质，并要求逮捕该人以防止可能发生的麻烦。据此，我们逮捕了蒋明日一人，并查获若干具有叛乱性质的文件，包括汉口永清宗路43号的蒋苏（Chiang Soo）写给蒋明日和凌清岱（Ling Ching Dai）的几封信件，内容涉及策划推翻郭的政变。因此，我们致电汉口卫戍司令夏（Au），请求其逮捕同伙。对此，上述当局后来回复称，蒋苏已被捕，他声称自己受聘为第二十六师顾问，并承担了推翻郭的活动；他们还询问是否可以将被告蒋明日和蒋苏送至贵师进行调查。关于此事，我们希望得到您的答复。
随函附上卫戍司令部原函副本、日本电报及其译文，以及蒋苏...所写的三封信件。

page_data.en:
Tsiang Ming-tsih (蒋明柱)
Szechnen                                J.S.Golder 118
2 p.m.              19/3/32             C.D.S.I.Huang

My name is Tsiang Ming-tsih (蒋明柱), native of Yin Yang
Hsian (雲陽), Szechuan. I am aged 56 years and married
to Tsiang Tsang Sze, also a native of Szechuen, who is
at present staying in my native place.
    I first went to School at the age of 8 years, when I
entered a family school in my native place continuing my
education there until the age of 18. At the age of 18 years
I took an examination, passed and became a scholar under
the Seu-Zai (Foreign Knowledge) system which was introduced
during the Ching Dynasty. I studied under a tutor in my
native place until I was 20 years of age, when I proceeded
to Peking and there took an examination at the 2nd Imperial
Academy. On passing this examination I was selected to
become a civil officer under the Imperial Government. I
remained in Peking for a period of about 6 years altogether
and then was sent to Soochow where I took over the post of
President of the Judicial Yuan. I actually took over the
office in 1910 one year before the revolution. At the
outbreak of the revolution I took up the post of secretary
to Sung Teh-chuan (程德全) who was that time a "President
of the Kiangsu Province". I proceeded with him to the
attack on Nanking which took place on 18th day of the 8th
moon 1911. The siege of Nanking lasted about one month
when the holders gave in. With the fall of Nanking I
left the employment of Sung Teh-chuan and entered the
service of Dr. Sun Yat-sen who had been elected temporary
President and had established his office in Nanking which
page_data.zh:
蒋明柱（Tsiang Ming-tsih）
四川                                J.S.Golder 118
下午2时              1932年3月19日             C.D.S.I.黄

我叫蒋明柱，四川云阳县（Yin Yang Hsian）人。现年56岁，已婚，妻子蒋藏氏（Tsiang Tsang Sze）亦为四川人，目前居住在家乡。
    我8岁开始上学，进入家乡的家塾读书，一直读到18岁。18岁时参加考试，及格后成为清朝引入的“西学”（Seu-Zai，即外国知识）体系下的生员。我在家乡跟随导师学习至20岁，随后前往北京，在那里参加了第二帝国学院（Imperial Academy）的考试。通过该考试后，我被选为清政府的文官。我在北京总共停留了约6年，然后被派往苏州，接任司法院院长一职。我实际上是在1910年就职的，即革命前一年。革命爆发时，我担任程德全（Sung Teh-chuan）的秘书，程当时是“江苏省总统”。我随他参加了1911年农历八月十八日对南京的进攻。南京围城战持续了约一个月，守军投降。随着南京陷落，我离开了程德全的幕府，进入当选为临时大总统并在南京（被选为临时首都）设立办公处的孙中山博士麾下服务，该

page_data.en:
-2-
city had been chosen as the temporary capital. About one
year after taking office as temporary president Dr. Sun Yat-
sen handed over office to Li Yuan-hung (黎元洪) who had been
selected as the first President and who had established his
government at Peking. With the formation of the new govern-
ment I left the services of Dr. Sun-Yat-sen and went to
Peking, entering the services of Li Yuan-hung as his secre-
tary and political advisor. When Li Yuan-hung completed
his term of office, I entered the service of Yuan Shih-kai
(袁世凯) who succeeded him. I remained in the employ of
Yuan Shih-kai (袁世凯) as secretary and political advisor
until his death, at which I took service in the same
capacity with Feng Kuo-chang (馮國璋). Feng's death
occurred about one year after he took office I therefore
entered the service of Hsu Shih-chang, who was the next
After being in office 2 years Hsu Shih-chang resigned
president. I did likewise and returned to my native
place in Szechwan. After being at home for a short period
I re-entered the service of the Republic and took up the
work as adviser to the offices of the Ministries of Finance
Education etc. During this period I paid numerous visits
to my native place. I finally left the service of the
government in 1929 when I made my last trip to Peking.
Soon after my resignation I went to Szechwan and remained
there for about two years during which time I prepared
manuscripts for books on politics, economics, philosophy
and law. I completed my work on the basis of the end of 1930.
I left Szechwan in April, and proceeded to Nanking at
page_data.zh:
-2-
城市被选为临时首都。孙中山博士就任临时大总统约一年后，将职位移交给被选为首任总统并在北京建立政府的黎元洪（Li Yuan-hung）。随着新政府的成立，我离开了孙中山博士的服务，前往北京，作为秘书和政治顾问进入黎元洪的幕府。当黎元洪任期届满时，我进入继任者袁世凯（Yuan Shih-kai）的幕府。我一直担任袁世凯的秘书和政治顾问直至其去世，随后我以同样的身份服务于冯国璋（Feng Kuo-chang）。冯国璋就职约一年后去世，因此我进入下一任总统徐世昌（Hsu Shih-chang）的幕府。徐世昌任职2年后辞职。我也同样辞职，回到四川家乡。在家短暂停留后，我重新进入民国政府服务，担任财政部、教育部等部的顾问。在此期间，我多次返回家乡。最终，我在1929年最后一次前往北京后离开了政府服务。辞职后不久，我前往四川，在那里停留了约两年，期间撰写了有关政治、经济、哲学和法律的书稿。我在1930年底完成了这项工作。我于4月离开四川，前往南京，在

page_data.en:
-3-
the instance of Shih Tsung-loo (史宗魯), commander of
the 4th Route Army in Kansu to apply to the Nanking govern-
ment for funds for the 4th Route Army. I went to the
military headquarters where I made application to General
Chu Pei-teh (朱培德), Chief of Staff. The application was
rejected as the funds at the time had not been raised.
Ten days later after my arrival in Nanking I was arrested
by the Nanking Garrison Commander's Headquarters on the
charge of fabricating rumours, starting agitation, and
conducting subversive correspondence in a secret code and
an attempted Coup d'Etat against General Kuo Ju-tung
(郭汝棟) of the 20th Army Corps in Szech. I was detained
in Headquarters of the Garrison Commander for about 4 months
On my release I took up residence in Nanking, remaining
there for about 2 months, then came to Shanghai arriving
here on November 25, 1931. I took a room in the Far
Eastern Hotel and later moved to the Central Hotel on Bhoot
Road. Later in the month of January I moved to my friend's
house in the Shih Wei Li, No.744, Seymour Road. My friend
Tseng Mo-sung (張樹聲) who resides at this address is
assistant to the Commander of the Kiangsu Bandit Suppression
Corps. Tseng told me that I could have a room on the
ground floor of No.744 Shih Wei Li, Seymour Road. Soon
after the start of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai I went to see D. Yamamoto at the Palace Hotel,
Room 136 and asked him to render me some assistance in
getting some of my friends out of the Chapei area.
page_data.zh:
-3-
应甘肃第四路军指挥官史宗魯（Shih Tsung-loo）之请，向南京政府申请第四路军经费。我前往军事总部，向参谋长朱培德（Chu Pei-teh）将军提出申请。该申请被驳回，理由是当时款项尚未筹集到位。

抵达南京十天后，我被南京卫戍司令部逮捕，罪名是制造谣言、煽动闹事、使用密码进行颠覆性通信，以及企图对驻四川的第二十军军长郭汝棟（Kuo Ju-tung）将军发动政变。我在卫戍司令部总部被拘留约四个月。获释后，我寓居南京，停留约两个月，随后前往上海，于1931年11月25日抵达此地。我先在远东饭店（Far Eastern Hotel）租了一间房，后来搬至蒲石路（Bhoot Road）的中汇大楼（Central Hotel）。同年一月下旬，我搬至西摩路744号施伟里（Shih Wei Li）的朋友家中。住在此址的朋友张树声（Tseng Mo-sung）是江苏剿匪指挥部指挥官的助理。张树声告诉我，我可以住在西摩路744号施伟里的一楼房间。上海中日战事爆发后不久，我去皇宫饭店（Palace Hotel）136室拜访了山本（D. Yamamoto），请他协助我将一些朋友从闸北地区撤出。

page_data.en:
-4-
All my dealings with Japanese have been for the same
purpose.
Hitherto I have omitted to state that about 19 years
I was superintendent in charge of Chinese students in
Japan and whilst there I made a number of Japanese friends.
page_data.zh:
-4-
我与日本人的所有交往均出于同一目的。
此前我未提及，大约19年前，我曾担任留日中国学生监督，在此期间结识了许多日本朋友。

page_data.en:
Translation of a document found during a raid on the
the home of Tsiang Ming Jih, No.744 Shih Wei Li,
Seymour Road at noon on March 19th, 1932.

Kuo, Commander of the 26th Division of the National Army,
According to the No.204 letter of the Garrison
Commander's Headquarters of Hankow, during the inspection
of postal matters they discovered a Japanese telegram
entitled "Telegram from the Song Dau (Japanese) Consul-
General at Tientsin to the Acting Consul-General Shigimitsu
of Shanghai" in company with a paper written according to
a secret code in a roll of mosquito paper sent to Tsiang
Ming Jih, Sing Hwa Hotel, Nanking, from Hankow and that
these documents are fabricating rumours, starting agitation
communicating under a secret code and of a rebellious character
and we are requested to arrest the person in order to
prevent possible embarrassment. In accordance with this
we have arrested one Tsiang Ming Jih and seized a number
of documents of a rebellious nature including several
letters from Chiang See, 43 Yung Tsing Tsung Road, Hankow,
to Tsiang Ming Jih, and Ling Ching Dai, in connection
with a proposed coup d'etat against Kuo. Accordingly
we replied Au (夏), the Garrison Commander of Hankow
by telegram and requested him to arrest the accomplices.
In answer to this we were later informed by the afore-
mentioned Authorities that one Chiang See had been arrest-
ed, who stated that he is engaged as an adviser of the
26th Division and undertook the activities of overthrow-
ing Kuo and they also asked if it is all right to send
these accused Tsiang Ming Jih and Chiang See to your
Division for investigation. Regarding this we would
like to get a reply from you.
Attached herewith is a copy of the original letter
from the Garrison Commander's Headquarters, the Japanese
telegram with translation and those letters written by
Chiang See.
page_data.zh:
1932年3月19日中午，在西摩路744号施伟里蒋明日（Tsiang Ming Jih）住所搜查期间发现的文件译文。

致国民革命军第二十六师师长郭：

据汉口卫戍司令部第204号函称，在检查邮政事务时，发现一卷从汉口寄往南京新华饭店蒋明日的蚊香纸中，夹有一份题为“天津日本总领事宋道（Song Dau，音译）致上海代理总领事重光”的日本电报，以及一份用密码书写的文件。这些文件涉嫌制造谣言、煽动闹事、使用密码通信，并具有反叛性质，为防止可能引起的尴尬局面，要求逮捕相关人员。据此，我们已逮捕蒋明日一人，并查获若干具有反叛性质的文件，包括几封由汉口永清总路43号的蒋世（Chiang See，音译）写给蒋明日和林镜台（Ling Ching Dai，音译）的信件，内容涉及针对郭的拟议政变。因此，我们已复电汉口卫戍司令夏（Au），请求其逮捕同伙。对此，上述当局后来通知我们，蒋世已被捕，他声称受聘为第二十六师顾问，并从事推翻郭的活动；他们还询问是否可以将被告蒋明日和蒋世送往贵师进行调查。关于此事，我们希望得到您的回复。

随函附上汉口卫戍司令部原函副本、日本电报及其译文，以及蒋世所写信件。

2月11日。

梅巴兄：

本公司已取得一定成功。

Februaru 11.

Brother Hung.

We have not corresponded to each other
for a long time . Our company has been organ-
ised with a little success. Certain Manager
(18 Ts ) Secret Code. has left here for Tientsin.
Why do you not go to Tientsin with Brother Mai,
possibility it would not be difficult to know the
time state. Maybe I shall go to the North in the
near future with a view to arranging a conference
among us. As a branch is opening here it is
possible that we shall ask you to come south .
Attached herewith is a note for Brother Mai.

Yours Faithfully

Ming.

P.S. The organisation of the company is very good
but for the present do not ask for other men
When you are in Tientsin look for those
acquaintances of the Kan Moh ( Tuan Gee-sai
clique and you will receive help.

2月11日。

洪兄：

我们已久未通信。本公司组织已初见成效。某经理（18 Ts，密码）已离此前往天津。你为何不与麦兄一同前往天津？届时了解时局状况或许并非难事。近期我或许会北上，以便安排我们之间的会议。由于此处正在开设分部，我们可能会请你南下。随函附上给麦兄的便条。

明

February 18.

Commander-in-Chief Uyeda,

It is three years since we saw you last;
have you an idea about the hearty talk and joking beside
the sea among us and Chuen Jee (南池) (Chief of Staff),
San Ya (三野) (Staff Officer), Chih Dien (吉田 )
(Interpreter and Advisor), when you were in command at
Tientsin and Taku. This time you came to Shanghai and
I too owing to some important affairs have arrived here.
I originally intended to have an interview with you,
but am not in position to do so due to my present
engagement. Therefore I have to write to you to
offer my good wishes. I am at present engaged in
the peace movement; you can get important particulars
from Dien Chung (田中 ), Pei Keng (北岡) Chun Tsing
(村井 ), and Kiang Gee (江崎) (all names of
Japanese).

As regards whether there is hope for peace and
other measures, please tell me through Brother Dien
Chung (田中 )

Yours faithfully,
Name on attached card.

P.S. The intimate friendship between the two nations
should be based on the people. Your Army is
famous for its civility; I hope that it will
not treat the people in a brutal manner, but will
be merciful towards them.

........

2月18日。

植田司令官阁下：

自上次拜别，已历三载；不知阁下是否还记得，当阁下在天津及大沽指挥期间，我们与您以及南池（Chuen Jee，参谋长）、三野（San Ya，参谋）、吉田（Chih Dien，翻译兼顾问）在海边畅谈欢笑的情景。此次阁下莅临上海，鄙人亦因要事抵沪。原本打算拜访阁下，但因目前事务缠身，未能如愿。故此致函，以表问候。鄙人目前正致力于和平运动；有关详情，可向田中（Dien Chung）、北岡（Pei Keng）、村井（Chun Tsing）及江崎（Kiang Gee）（均为日本人姓名）查询。

关于和平是否有望及其他措施，请通过田中（Dien Chung）兄告知我。

此致
敬礼
署名见附名片。

又及：两国之亲密友谊应基于人民。贵军以文明著称，希望贵军不要粗暴对待百姓，而应予以宽待。

--

December 21,

Minister Shigemitsu,

I beg to inform you that I arrived
in Shanghai yesterday and would like to have an interview
with you. If you have time, I shall come to you and
have a hearty talk with you. Besides I have some
important affairs to discuss with you.

Yours faithfully,
Sd. Chiang Zu-lih
(alias Ming Jih)

P.S. I appreciate your introduction to me last year
of Consul Shang Tsuan (上村) who had several
negotiations with me which resulted in satisfaction.
I met brethren Kai Kong (北岡), Dien Chung (田中),
Chung Tsing (村) yesterday. I told them to
convey the matter to you and I believe that they have
dealt it with you already. I hope that you will appoint
a date for an interview.

(Note: The last three names mentioned in P.S. are
all of Japanese).

---
December 31
Mr. King Jih,
My friend Liu Ching-san's men have
about 5,000 rifles and are at present distributed
on the border of Kiangsu and Shantung. I request
you to try to find some one in Shanghai to collect
them and organize them, whereby we can make a
fundamental force out of them with a view to
completing the Chinese Revolution. It will be
best to have a discussion with you, assistant.
Hoping that you will favour me with a reply,
Yours faithfully,
Cheng Chi-ming.

P.S. In 1924 Sun Yat-sen appointed Mu as Commander
of the 11th Army. During the Northern Punitive
Drive, he was appointed by Chiang as Commander-
in-Chief of the Kiao Tung People Group and at
present acts as Major General Military Advisor.
Li Chi-sen is at present Director of Military
Training; have you any connection with him and
can you introduce me to him?

12月31日
金极（King Jih）先生：
吾友刘景山（Liu Ching-san）部拥有步枪约5000支，目前分布在江苏与山东边境。请阁下设法在上海找人收集并整编这些枪支，以便将其打造为一支基本力量，以完成中国革命。最好能与阁下这位助手进行讨论。
盼复，
此致
敬礼
郑基明（Cheng Chi-ming）。

又及：1924年孙中山任命穆（Mu）为第十一军军长。在北伐期间，他被蒋介石任命为胶东民团总指挥，目前担任少将军事顾问。李济深（Li Chi-sen）目前任军事训练总监；阁下与他有联系吗？能否将我引荐给他？

the home of Tsiang mingjih, 744 Shih wei Li,
Seymour Road at 12 noon March 19, 1932.

Ming,

I am very glad to hear that Tsou Sung will
proceed to Hupeh and I hold the following opinion :

1. As the matter according to Sun Ah-deu (? Sun Fo)
will be announced at a time when everything had
been properly arranged and it is believed that the
"Straw Head General" (Chiang Kai-shek) will not
meddle with it. Will you advise Tsing not to
worry any more. He (? Tsou Sung)) will go to
Nanking to exert all his energy to assist in
accomplishing the matter.

2. As regard Mo Nghis (Feng) case, the official
circle exerts every effort to prove that it is
groundless. Have you heard any evidence regarding
the same?

3. As there is assistance from the Interior, the
situation will not be affected and as the
influence of the bandits will be intensified during the
present national crisis in Hupeh, it is very needful
to have a stable commander. The present unsettled
situation will profit a wise person who can pick up
an excellent chance through it.

(sd.) Han Ts-ching

---

Envelope: Chiang Esq.,
Mingjih
c/o 744 Shih wei Li, Seymour Road.

Awaiting reply. From Zing Ming.

明：

获悉邹松（Tsou Sung）将赴湖北，不胜欣喜，我有如下意见：

1. 根据孙阿斗（Sun Ah-deu，？孙科）的意见，此事将在一切安排妥当后公布，相信“草头将军”（蒋介石）不会从中干涉。请劝告青（Tsing）不必再担忧。他（？邹松）将前往南京，竭尽全力协助促成此事。

2. 关于莫尼斯（Mo Nghis，冯）一案，官方正竭力证明其毫无根据。阁下是否听到有关此事的任何证据？

3. 由于有内地援助，局势不会受到影响；且鉴于当前湖北国难期间匪患影响将加剧，非常需要一位稳定的指挥官。目前的动荡局势有利于智者，使其能从中抓住绝佳机会。

（签署）韩子英（Han Ts-ching）

---

信封：蒋先生，
明极
转交西摩路慈惠里744号。

候复。来自 Zing Ming。

Representatives of P.S.B. :- A despatch from the P.S.B. was sent to
to this Court this morning for the extradition of the accused. I ask
the Court to hand them over to us, as it has been the ruling in this
Court to hand accused over in cases like this. I also ask that the
documents and other property seized be handed over to us with the ac-
cused.

Mr. Sung Yue Sung:- I ask the Court to give the accused a chance
for explanation for two or three minutes.

Judge to Mr. Sung:- You may explain now.

Mr. Sung:- According to Article 15 of the Criminal Procedure the
residence of the accused should be taken into consideration in this
case. All the accused reside in the Settlement and are therefore sub-
ject to the Jurisdiction of this Court. The second point, is if they
are handed over, they should not be handed over to the P.S.B. but to
the Kiangsu High Court. The third point, according to Article 21 of
the Criminal Procedure the accused should not be handed over to the
P.S.B. The fourth point, the Martial Law at Nantao, has not effected
in the Settlement, and therefore should not be handed over to the Ch-
inese Authorities. It is absolutely right to have the case tried in
this Court in which a Procurator sits with the Judge. It is the Civil
right of the accused to be tried before a Judicial Court to which the
Jurisdiction is subject. If according to the Rendition Agreement the
the accused are handed over, there is no use to make enquiries and no
use to prove a prima facie case if the Court has deemed to hand them
over. I ask that the execution of this be temporary suspended.

Judge to Mr. Sung:- This case was first discovered by the P.S.B.

For that they during the month of March 1932 at Shanghai

Proceedings.
Mr. Lea appeared for the Police.
Mr. Sung Yue Sung appeared for the 1st, 4th & 6th accused.
Mr. Sung Vung Dong for the 4th accused.
Mr. Yue Yau for the 2nd, 3rd, and 9th accused.

Mr. Lea:- At 4.10.p.m. on the 2th 12/3/32 a detective named Ng
Siau Fung from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau went to Louze Stat-
ion and reported that there were a number of persons in Rooms No.34
and 29 in the Great Eastern Hotel plotting to overthrow the present
Safety Bureau and the Volunteer Corps in Nantao. He also asked for
assistance to raid these rooms. The Police gave them assistance and
went there and arrested the 1st to the 9th accused as well as findi-
ng many documents, shops and flags in the room. These things are of
an illegal organization called "The Self-Defence Army". House No.7
of Rue Chapsel was also raided and more documents were found relati-

Lea先生：- 1932年3月12日下午4时10分，上海公安局一名名叫Ng Siau Fung的侦探前往老闸捕房，报告称在大东旅馆34号和29号房间内有多人密谋推翻南市目前的公安局和义勇队。他还请求协助突击搜查这些房间。警方给予协助并前往该处，逮捕了第1至第9号被告，并在房间内发现许多文件、印章和旗帜。这些物品属于一个名为“自卫军”的非法组织。随后还突击搜查了查普萨尔路（Rue Chapsel）7号房屋，发现了更多与该组织有关的文件。接着突击搜查了白尼蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier Montmorand）26号房屋，在那里逮捕了第10和第11号被告。该局代表已在法庭，他将申请移交被告。警方对引渡事宜不持意见，我们完全将其交由法庭处理。

It was the 9th accused who asked me to go to the room No.34 of the Great Eastern Hotel. The 9th accused was formerly the Chief of Staff in the 29th Army. I went to the Hotel on the 11/3/32. On the 12/3/32 I went there again. I do not know the 1st accused or anything about the "Self-Defence Army. The 9th accused asked me to go to the Hotel and he promised to get me a job. I would like to be tried in this Court, because then I would have a chance to explain.

9th Accused :- I am a returned student from Japan. The statement

is Soong S Tsang. "Zau Yao" is not my alias. "Yau Yao" is the name

续。由自卫军重组。在酒店里，我看见第一被告将3,000.00美元交给蒋松道（Kiang Sung Dao）。第一被告不是“李鄂”（Lee Ngoh），“李鄂”是个胖子。蒋松道是我的朋友，他参加了自卫军。“蒋”后来背叛了我们，这就是我们被捕的原因。我要求也对他进行处理，因为他也是此事的参与者之一。我反对被移交给公安局。

第八被告回答法官：- 庭上的名片是我的。1932年3月12日，我去第五被告家中拜访了他，随后我们去了东亚大酒店29号房间，在那里我们被捕。我不认识第九被告。当我们刚进去时，第七被告就在29号房间里。我反对被移交给公安局。

第九被告：- 我是从日本归国的留学生。我在警局所做的陈述自相矛盾，因为翻译不能完全表达我的本意。我是去年二月认识第一被告的。1932年3月9日，他来到我家，但没有见到我。后来，他给我寄了一张便条，叫我去东亚大酒店，我便去那里见了他。他跟我谈了关于组建自卫军的事。他告诉我，南市公安局和义勇队都愿意接受重组。我建议他，如果这样一支军队不危害公众，就可以组建。我还跟他谈到了反蒋（Tsiang Ka Zah），因为他在东三省对日本入侵采取不抵抗政策。我反对被移交给公安局，因为我在这里有充分的机会进行解释。

第十被告：- 我与宋志良（Soong Chi Liang）及第十一被告住在布伦尼埃·蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier Montmorand）26号。第十一被告是我的侄子，宋增藏（Soong S Tsang）也是我的侄子。“Zau Yao”不是我的别名。“Yau Yao”是我亲戚的名字。庭上的那封信是一个名叫唐松（Tong Sung）的人写的，并不是写给我的。宋宗乐（Soong Zung Le）是我兄弟的名字。我对自卫军一无所知。我认识第二和第三被告。

cousin. Soong Zung Sah is the name of the father of Soong Sah Tsaung
I work in the Arsenal and I earn $9.00 per month. I object to being
handed over. I can furnish security.

Wit. Kiang Sung Dao :- I am a Detective Inspector of the Public
Safety Bureau. I admitted to Court that I took part in the organiz-
ation of the Self Defense Army on behalf of the Public Safety Bureau
but I arrested these accused because the League Commission will ar-
rive today in Shanghai and it would be a disgrace to China if any
violence should occur now in Nantao. The 7th. accused is my friend
and he asked me to assist in the organisation of the Self Defence
Army about a month ago. Afterwards he effected some arrangements with
a man named Sung Tsa Chu who is a detective in charge of the 8th.
Division of the P.S.Bureau.I am certain of this as Sung phoned to
me about the matter at 5..p.m. on the 8th. inst. At 4.0.p.m. on the
9th. inst. the 7th. came to my house and gave me $100.00. and later
Sung came and gave me two powers of attorney. They told me that I had
been appointed a Brigade General in the newly-organised army. They
also told me that Mr. Wellington Koo had assumed responsibility for
foreign affairs and that Mr. Sung Fo would provide financial support
and further, that Tseu Vung Gee would attend to military supplies.
When they left I reported this to my superior officer Wong Ming; The
latter then got into touch with Wellington Koo and Sun Fo but they
denied all knowledge of the Self-Defense Army. The 7th. sent a chop
to my house on the afternoon of the 10th. asking Sung S Chu and my-
self to accompany him on a visit to the commander-in-chief Tseu Vung
Gee. He told me that the 1st. was the chief director of the army;
the 9th. the chief-of-staff, the 3rd. the secretary and the 4th. a

第十一被告：- 第十被告是我的叔叔。我住在他家里。（原文此处似有误，前文称第十一被告是第十被告的侄子，此处又重复“第十一被告是...”可能指代另一人或笔误，依原文译出）第十一被告是兵工厂的一名教师。宋基良（Soong Kyi Lieng）是我的表亲。宋增萨（Soong Sah Tsaung）的父亲名叫宋宗萨（Soong Zung Sah）。我在兵工厂工作，月薪9.00美元。我反对被移交。我可以提供保释金。

证人蒋松道（Kiang Sung Dao）：- 我是公安局的探长。我在法庭上承认，我代表公安局参与了自卫军的组织工作，但我逮捕这些被告是因为国联调查团今天将抵达上海，如果此时南市发生任何暴力事件，将是中国的耻辱。第七被告是我的朋友，大约一个月前他请我协助组织自卫军。后来，他与一名叫宋查楚（Sung Tsa Chu）的人达成了一些安排，此人是公安局第八分局负责侦缉工作的探员。我对此确信无疑，因为本月8日下午5点，宋就此事给我打了电话。本月9日下午4点，第七被告来到我家，给了我100.00美元，随后宋来了，给了我两份委任状。他们告诉我，我被任命为新组建军队的旅长。他们还告诉我，顾维钧先生已负责外交事务，宋佛（Sung Fo，音译，疑指孙科 Sun Fo）将提供财政支持，此外，朱永吉（Tseu Vung Gee，音译）将负责军需供应。他们离开后，我向我的上级王明（Wong Ming）汇报了此事；后者随即与顾维钧和孙科取得联系，但他们均否认对自卫军有任何了解。第十日下午，第七被告派人送了一枚印章到我家，要求宋查楚和我陪同他去拜访总司令朱永吉。他告诉我，第一被告是军队的总指挥；第九被告是参谋长；第三被告是秘书；第四被告是

and to supply 1,500 rifles. At 1.0.p.m. on the same day the 7th

appointment in the army as the chief of the Nantao Safety Bureau.
They also planned the overthrow of the Municipality of Greater

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appoint-
ment were seized in the rooms, which prove the arrested
men to belong to an organisation which they call "Head-
quarters of the 1st Brigade, 2nd General Group of the
South East Self-Defense Army.

As far as can be ascertained the object of the
plot was to buy over the Public Safety Bureau and the
heads of the heads of the various administration Offices
of the Greater Shanghai Municipality and then form the
"South East Self-Defense Army" of men picked from the
Chinese Police and the Chinese Merchant Volunteer Corps.

Several appointments have already been issued for
Commissions in this army, two of which were handed over,
by the 7th accused on 11-3-32, to Zang Zah Jui ( )
Chief Captain of the 8th Division, Nantao Police and
Kiang Sung Sen ( ). Chief Captain of the Nantao
Public Safety Bureau, appointing them as Brigade Comman-
der and Battalion Commander, respectively of the afore-
mentioned army.

page_data.en:
Sol., S.B.
March 14, 32

Arrest of 'Revolutionaries' in the Settlement

// and Superintendent Robertson

At 4.10 p.m. March 12, members of the Public
Safety Bureau requested assistance from Louza Station to
arrest persons who were using Rooms 29 and 34 of the Great
Eastern Hotel, Kia Wo Kan, off Nanking Road as a meeting
place where they were plotting the overthrow of the Public
Safety Bureau and the Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
A party of Municipal Police attended and the following nine
persons were arrested:

Lee Hing-tseong ( )
Li Sing-ngah ( )
Soong Suh-tsang ( )
Chou Tsz-mih ( )
Chiu Keng-sung ( )
Iung Ngoh-ding ( )
Teong Zeong-pung ( )
Sung Ngoh-on ( )
Tsang Ming-yuen ( )

A quantity of papers, chops and letters of appoint-
ment were seized showing the arrested men to belong to an
organization known as the "Headquarters of the South-Eastern
Self Defence Army"( ). At 9.30 p.m. on the
same day Municipal Police with the assistance of members
of the French Police and Native Police searched the home
of the 2nd accused Lee Sing-ngah ( ) at 7 Rue Chapel
and seized a suitcase containing documents and correspondence
and in addition visited the home of the third accused Soong
Suh-tsang ( ) at 35 Sing Ming Tsang Alleyway,
Rue Recteur de Jessé (where a box containing documents
and correspondence was seized and the two premises of Officer
page_data.zh:
Sol., S.B.
1932年3月14日

租界内“革命党人”之逮捕

// 及罗伯逊巡官

3月12日下午4时10分，公安局成员请求老闸捕房协助，逮捕那些利用南京路附近嘉禾馆 (Kia Wo Kan) 大华饭店 (Great Eastern Hotel) 29号和34号房间作为集会地点的人，他们在此策划推翻公安局及大上海市政府。
一队工部局警察到场，以下九人被捕：

Lee Hing-tseong ( )
Li Sing-ngah ( )
Soong Suh-tsang ( )
Chou Tsz-mih ( )
Chiu Keng-sung ( )
Iung Ngoh-ding ( )
Teong Zeong-pung ( )
Sung Ngoh-on ( )
Tsang Ming-yuen ( )

查获大量文件、印章和委任状，显示被捕者属于一个名为“东南自卫军总部” ( ) 的组织。同日晚上9时30分，工部局警察在法国警察和华人警察成员的协助下，搜查了第二被告 Li Sing-ngah ( ) 位于 Chapel 路7号的住所，查获一只装有文件和信件的皮箱，此外还走访了第三被告 Soong Suh-tsang ( ) 位于 Rue Recteur de Jessé 新明洋行弄堂35号的住所（在此查获一只装有文件和信件的箱子，并将该处发现的两名职员

page_data.en:
-2-

found on the premises, taken into custody
    Soong Pah-dau        (        )
    . Zau Wei-sien       (        )
The seizure at this address, on examination, however, proved of
no value and had no bearing on the case.

    From statements made by the accused (copies of which
are attached) it appears that the Public Safety Bureau and
the offices of the various organs of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai were to be occupied by the South-Eastern Self
Defence Army at a certain time on March 13. The nucleus of
this army was to consist of members of the Public Safety
Bureau and the Merchants Volunteer Corps for which assistance
$100,000 was to be paid and 2,000 rifle supplied to the
representative of the Bureau in question together with an
assurance that no dismissal or change of the present staff
of the Public Safety Bureau would be affected. The new
army when formed would be commanded by General Chow Feng-chi
(        ), who according to the statement of the first
principal accused Li Hing-tseng, engineered the plot under
the name of Li Ngoh (        ).
    General Chen Feng-chi who resides at 146 Rue Pere
Robert is notorious for his treachery against Lu Yung-hsiang
(        ), Tutan of Chekiang, when he was overthrown by
Sun Chuan Fang and against the latter when the Nationalists
entered Chekiang in 1927. For his desertion of Sun Chuan-
fang the Nationalists appointed him commander of the 26th
Army which occupied Chapai and Nantao in 1927. He held
this post for about six months when his command was given
page_data.zh:
-2-

拘捕
    Soong Pah-dau        (        )
    . Zau Wei-sien       (        )
然而，经查证，在该地址查获的物品毫无价值，与本案无关。

    根据被告所作的供词（副本附后），看来东南自卫军计划于3月13日的某个时刻占领公安局及大上海市政府各机关办公室。这支军队的核心将由公安局成员和商团义勇队组成，为此将支付10万美元援助，并向有关局的代表提供2,000支步枪，同时保证不对公安局现有人员进行解职或变动。新军队组建后，将由周凤岐将军 (        ) 指挥，据第一主犯 Li Hing-tseng 供称，周以 Li Ngoh (        ) 之名策划了此次阴谋。
    居住在 Pere Robert 路146号的陈凤岐将军因背叛浙江督军卢永祥 (        ) 而臭名昭著，当时卢被孙传芳推翻；后来当国民党于1927年进入浙江时，他又背叛了孙传芳。因其背叛孙传芳，国民党任命他为第26军军长，该军于1927年占领了闸北和南市。他担任此职约六个月，后因蒋介石怀疑其忠诚度，其指挥权被移交

page_data.en:
-3-

to General Chen I (        ) owing to Chiang Kai-shek's doubt
as to his, Chou's, loyalty. Again in December 1929 Chou
planned a Coup d'Etat in Hangchow but the plot was discovered
before maturity and Chou was forced to flee.
        The statement of the 9th accused, Tsang Ming-yuan
(        ), a graduate of the Tokio Military Academy shows
him up as an individual who has lived on political and
military intrigue for the past twenty four years and a very
suitable man to assist in a plot of this kind.
        The accused have been charged with Insurrection
Contrary to Art. 103 of the C.C.R.C. and will appear before
Court on March 14 when an application for their extradition
will be made by the Chinese Authorities.

                                        Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
page_data.zh:
-3-

给陈仪将军 (        )。此外，周于1929年12月又在杭州策划政变，但阴谋在成熟前被发现，周被迫逃亡。
        第九被告 Tsang Ming-yuan (        ) 的供词显示，他是东京陆军士官学校毕业生，在过去二十四年里一直靠政治和军事阴谋为生，是非常适合协助此类阴谋的人选。
        被告被控犯有违反《中华民国刑法》第103条之内乱罪，并将于3月14日出庭，届时中国当局将提出引渡申请。

page_data.en:
Serial No.1

Translation of a draft of a document found in Room 29,
Great Eastern Hotel, at 4.20 p.m. March 12, 1932.

Instructions issued by the Field Headquarters
of the Commander-in-Chief. (Time) .........
March 12, 1932.

1) This Army takes upon itself the greatest task of saving
the country from the present crisis and improving the
political administrations by getting rid of all forms
of corruption. It has been decided that the whole body
of the army will gather together at the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai on the forenoon of ......... inst.
so as to take an oath expressing their determination to
resist the aggression of our strong neighbouring country
and to establish a genuine democratic rule.

2) Wang Ming, Commander of the 3rd Division and concurrently
Provisional Martial Law Commander at Shanghai, is hereby
ordered to lead a number of his men and occupy the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau before .... A.M. March 13. After the
occupation of the Bureau and the despatch of men for the usual
post and scouting duties for the purpose of enforcing
precautionary measures, the rest of Wang's officers and men
are to proceed to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
before ......A.M. March 13 to await further instructions.

3) Weng Ling (王麟), Special Duty Officer of the Bureau
of Public Safety, is hereby ordered to lead his men to
undertake precautionary measures along the route from the
Small East Gate to the Public Safety Bureau from .....(time)
to ...... (time). After this, (Weng and his men) should
proceed to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai to await
instructions.

List of property seized in Room No.34, Great Eastern Hotel,
King Hwa Rd., rented in the name of Lee Min Tsoong (李敏生),
at 4.20 p.m. March 12, 1932.

1. Blue cloth flag bearing the inscription of "Headquarters of
the South-Eastern Self Defence Army" 東南自衛軍第三師司令部

2. 1 written note stating as follows:-
"I shall come at 4 p.m. to-day to discuss the matter.
Please inform all comrades to attend."
Signed and chopped by
Wong Ming (黃明)。

3. 7 letters of appointment issued by/the Headquarters of Lee Ngoh
(李), Commander-in-Chief of the "Headquarters of the South
Eastern Self Defence Army", to the following persons :
1) Tsu Tao Dong (朱作同) as the Superintendent of the
Bureau of Public Utility.
2) Song Zau Yao (宋兆堯) as staff officer holding the
rank of colonel.
3) Li Tieh Kong (李鐵公) as the Special Deputy of the
Wireless Administration Bureau.
4) Tseng Ming Yuen (張明遠) as the Staff Officer and
Chief of Staff, Headquarters, South Eastern Self De-
fence Army.
5) Li Zau Tseng (李佐曾) as the Chief of General Staff
Headquarters, South Eastern Self Defence Army.
6) Song Sz Tsaung (宋式璋) as the Chief of Secretariat
Headquarters, South Eastern Self Defence Army.
7) Tseu Koen Dzung (周幹臣) as Senior Military Advisor
Headquarters, South Eastern Self Defence Army.

4. 2 drafts of circulars addressed to the people by Li Ngoh (李壑)
and others of the Headquarters of South Eastern Self Defence
Army, to be despatched through various provincial, Hsien and other
official organs and newspaper offices, denouncing non-reinforce-
ments to the 19th Route Army which led to its subsequent re-
treat during the Sino-Japanese conflict in Shanghai, condemning
General Chiang Kai Shek to have caused the Japanese aggression
and civil strife, and announcing the object of the organization
of a South Eastern Self Defence Army to resist Japan and to save
the nation.

5) 1 map of Chekiang Province.
李 張 周
6) 1 envelop addressed to Messrs. Li and Tsang by Tseu.

7) 1 envelop addressed to Wong Tsong Zung (王仲仁) Great China
University by Ming (明) from Room No. 34, Dah Dong Lodging
House, Chun San Road. Enclosed letter to ask a loan of $50.00
to defray hotel expenses.

8) 1 draft of an incomplete speech announcing that the South Eas-
tern Self Defence Army, which is organized by the people, has
no party spirit, and that Chiang Kai Shek was formally a loa-
fer.

9) 4 name cards bearing the following names:-
1) James H. Tso (祝志偉) Boone College, C.M.U. Wuchang.
2) Henry T.Z. Huang (黃子健) Secretary, Sung Ming Cotton
3) Li Wing Hoong (李詠洪) Mgr. & Wkg. Co., 50 Kiangse Rd.
Shanghai.

10) 14 copies of Summarised regulations governing a children's
hospital at No. 137 Rd. Joffre.

11) A quantity of blank envelopes and paper.

1. 一面蓝布旗，上书“东南自卫军第三师司令部”字样。

2. 一张字条，内容如下：-
“我将于今日下午4时前来商议此事。
请通知各位同志出席。”
由黄明（Wong Ming）签名并盖章。

3. “东南自卫军司令部”总司令李壑（Li Ngoh）签发给下列人员的委任状7份：
1) 朱作同（Tsu Tao Dong）任公用局局长。
2) 宋兆堯（Song Zau Yao）任上校参谋。
3) 李鐵公（Li Tieh Kong）任无线电台管理局特派副职。
4) 張明遠（Tseng Ming Yuen）任东南自卫军司令部参谋兼参谋长。
5) 李佐曾（Li Zau Tseng）任东南自卫军司令部参谋长。
6) 宋式璋（Song Sz Tsaung）任东南自卫军司令部秘书长。
7) 周幹臣（Tseu Koen Dzung）任东南自卫军司令部高级军事顾问。

4. 东南自卫军司令部李壑（Li Ngoh）等人致民众的通函草稿2份，拟通过各省、县及其他官方机构和报社发出，谴责因未对第十九路军进行增援导致其在上海中日冲突中随后撤退，谴责蒋介石将军导致日本侵略和内乱，并宣布组建东南自卫军以抗日救国的宗旨。

5) 浙江省地图1幅。
李 張 周
6) 周先生致李先生和张先生的信封1个。

7) 明（Ming）从春山路（Chun San Road）大东旅馆（Dah Dong Lodging House）34号房寄给大夏大学王仲仁（Wong Tsong Zung）先生的信封1个。内附信件请求借款50.00美元以支付酒店费用。

8) 一篇未完成的演讲草稿，宣称由民众组织的东南自卫军没有党派色彩，并称蒋介石从前是个游手好闲之徒。

9) 名片4张，姓名如下：-
1) James H. Tso (祝志偉)，武昌华中大学（C.M.U.）博文学院。
2) Henry T.Z. Huang (黃子健)，秘书，松明棉花
3) Li Wing Hoong (李詠洪)，经理，江西路50号华兴公司（Wkg. Co.），上海。

10) 霞飞路137号儿童医院管理规章摘要14份。

11) 空白信封和纸张若干。
